subject: Jaroo
fact: Jaroo recalled the Moathouse as the outpost of the Temple of Elemental Evil and its role in enslaving and expanding its influence.
source_quote: “The mouthouse was once the outpost of the Temple of Elemental Evil, its watchtower an advance base for raids, looting, and destruction. From this area, servants of the Temple were to bring the Village of Hommlet and all the lands around it into subjection. The temple enslaved the conquered folk, and then they were forced to construct yet another fortress further west, spreading the evil power of the Temple in ever-growing rings to encompass all of the lands around its base.”

subject: Bluish Stone Line

subject: Disappearance of the Previous Priest

subject: Pattern of Outposts
fact: The newly uncovered outposts mirror the concentric expansion pattern of the original Temple of Elemental Evil. Jaroo believes this is not coincidence — suggesting the Temple’s influence is reemerging, and the party must investigate the Moathouse to uncover its revival.

subject: bandit ambush and interrogation
fact: Zephyr uses an illusion to get bandits to open the door; Zephyr, Zinia, and Sequoia sneak in one at a time; Zephyr kills the leader and indicates seven more left; Zinia kills one quietly; Sequoia kills two bandits; three bandits escape through an enlarged arrow slit; Sequoia kills one more and blocks the exit; Zinia knocks out the last bandit; Voss is interrogated and reveals he was given the symbol by his boss; Calmer’s explanation of St. Cuthbert’s punishments terrifies Voss; Sequoia comforts him and learns the symbol meant belonging.
source_quote: A sudden bang is heard in the room just outside the door. “Zephyr has used an illusion to get the folks inside to open the door for us,” thinks Sequoia. The door opens, and a man in scruffy, dirty clothes with yellowing teeth peers through. He then retreats into the door, and there is muttering. Sequoia can’t understand what they are saying. The two rogues and the monk co-ordinate with hand gestures. They will sneak into the room one at a time, attack, and retreat. Sequoia waits as Zephyr enters. He hears a body fall to the ground. As Zephyr exits, he indicates seven more left and that the leader is dead. Sequoia waits as Zinia enters. The satisfying sound of a body hitting the ground quietly precedes Zinia’s return. The rogue sneaks in the past through the door and sees the bandit leader dead on the ground, pooling in blood in the middle of the room. To his left is another dead bandit. Sequoia kills one with his shortswords and then leaves the chamber. The bandits recover from the shock of the surprise attack and start screaming that they have to get out of there. Three of the bandits escape to the south through an arrow slit that has been enlarged to allow easy retreat. Sequoia kills one more of the bandits and then stands in front of the exit, blocking it. He turns to Zinia, “Keep him alive. We want to interrogate him.” Zinia knocks him out with a flurry of blows. Voss then starts to cry hysterically and in panic. Calmer offers to help, but apparently, Calmer’s idea of calming a man terrified of being killed by an Evil Cult is to explain to him what the Church of St. Cuthbert does to its enemies. Sequoia pushes the cleric away and sits down next to Voss. He says, “Look, I know you are just a desperate man caught up in something bigger than themselves. And I really don’t need to hand you over to the authorities. I just need to know what this symbol is.” Voss looks at him, “It’s what the big boss gave the boss who gave it to us. It meant we belonged.”

subject: Moathouse
fact: The Moathouse is surrounded by a scrub of thorns, thistles, weeds, and shrubs along the track leading to the ruins; the track is mostly overgrown, cluttered with fallen branches and trees, washed out in places, mired in others, and the land sinks and becomes boggy near the entrance; tall marsh plants grow thickly where cattails and tamaracks do not; the bogs stink; the vegetation appears dense and prolific but sickly and unhealthy; creepers and vines throw their strangling loops over the skeletons of dead saplings and living bushes alike; the rushes and cattails rustle and bend even to a slight zephyr; weird birdcalls, croakings, and other unwholesome sounds come faintly across the fen; a side path, banked high to cross over the wetland, leads just north to the entrance of the ruin; the track is only about 15 feet wide with crumbling embankments making travel near the edge dangerous.
source_quote: A scrub of thorns, thistles, weeds, and shrubs grows thickly along the edge of the track leading to the ruins. Even the track is mostly overgrown and cluttered with fallen branches and trees. Here and there, it is washed out, in other places a mire. Some game evidently still follows the pathway, however, for after a mile or sofaint traces can be seen. But even considering this, going is slow, and it takes over an hour to reach the place on horseback, or two to trudge along on foot. Considerable hacking and clearing is necessary to make the way passable, so double the time required for the first trip. After two miles, as the track turns more northerly, the land begins to sink and become boggy. Tall marsh plants grow thickly where cattails and tamaracks do not. Off to the left can be seen the jagged silhouette of the moathouse. A side path, banked high to cross over the wetland to either side, just north to the entrance of the ruin. The track here is only about 15 feet wide or so, with crumbling embankments making travel near the edge dangerous. The bogs stink. The vegetation appears dense and prolific, but somehow sickly and unhealthy, creepers and vines throwing their strangling loops over the skeletons of dead saplings and living bushes alike. The rushes and cattails rustle and bend even to a slight zephyr, and weird birdcalls, croakings, and other unwholesome sounds come faintly across the fen.

source_quote: Sequoia - Early Afternoon, Planting 19, 579

subject: Evening, Planting 18, 579
fact: On this date, the party ambushed the bandits, killed the captain and mooks, and rescued Tort. Zephyr interrogated him, extracting fragments of information about the Duke. Sequoia and Zinnia coordinated the operation, establishing their roles as tactical leaders. The events of this evening confirmed the existence of multiple factions in conflict.

subject: Morning, Planting 19, 579
fact: On this date, the party entered the moathouse dungeon and used Calmer to clear zombies. Zinnia discovered the secret door via blood trail, Sequoia identified the crypt, and Zephyr forced Calmer to retrieve treasure. The Fire Temple robes were taken, and the first major dungeon layer was secured. This day marked the transition from investigation to active exploration.

subject: Morning, Planting 20, 579
fact: On this date, the party explored the southern passageway of the moathouse, encountered the giant crayfish, and retrieved the ruby pin. Sequoia discovered the northern passageway leading to unknown chambers. The party’s resources are depleted, and they are preparing to rest — but the secret shaft remains unexplored, and the identity of the Duke’s master is still unknown.

subject: Planting 18, 579
fact: On Planting 18, 579, the ambush, rescue, interrogation, and killing of the bandits occurred. The same day, the party moved to the moathouse and began their investigation into the Duke’s network.
source_quote: Zephyr - Afternoon, Planting 18, 579... Zinnia - Evening, Planting 18, 579

subject: Planting 18, 579
fact: The date on which the party descended into the moathouse, encountered monsters, freed prisoners, and uncovered a grim history of captivity and consumption.
source_quote: Date: Planting 18, 579

subject: Planting 18, 579
fact: The events of the repast for the ogre unfold on Planting 18, 579, beginning with the group's descent into the moathouse and culminating in the discovery of prisoners, zombies, and the Ogre's lair.
source_quote: Date: Planting 18, 579

subject: Planting 19, 579
fact: On Planting 19, 579, the party disposed of the bandits’ bodies and entered the moathouse dungeon, where Calmer revealed his divine power. This marked the transition from investigation to confrontation.
source_quote: Sequoia - Morning, Planting 19, 579

subject: Planting 20, 579
fact: The date Planting 20, 579 is the temporal anchor for the events of the infiltration and meeting with Lareth the Beautiful.

subject: session date
fact: The next day's events occur on Planting 19, 579.
source_quote: ## Date: Planting 19, 579

subject: session date
fact: The session continues on Planting 19, 579.
source_quote: ## Date: Planting 18, 579

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the Afternoon of Planting 18, 579.
source_quote: Zephyr - Afternoon, Planting 18, 579

subject: session date
fact: The session takes place on Planting 18, 579.
source_quote: ## Date: Planting 18, 579

subject: Acquisition of Spellbook and Scrolls
fact: Spugnoir gained access to a rich collection of spells from a dead cultist’s spellbook and scrolls, including misty step, rope trick, fly, and protection from good and evil. This significantly increased his magical utility to the party and altered his perceived value.

subject: armor destroyed by slime
fact: The green slime eats through Calmer's armor.
source_quote: the slime ate through it.

subject: bluff attempt on guard
fact: Zephyr bluffs the guard into believing they are loyal cultists.
source_quote: *The guard is convinced. Excellent.*

subject: Burne
fact: Burne commended the party for their information and deputation.
source_quote: I want to commend our heroes for their information.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer claims to just guard the group’s stuff.
source_quote: I just guard your stuff. You guys are the heroes.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer mutters about the fire temple robes being authentic or faked.
source_quote: Either the Temple is alive and well, or someone is doing a fantastic job of faking it.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer noticed the green slime hanging over the arch just in time.
source_quote: I noticed, just in time, the blob of green slime hanging over the arch at the bottom of the stairwell.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer uses his divine power to drive away zombies.
source_quote: By the Power of St Cuthbert, BEGONE ZOMBIES!!!

subject: Calmer’s clerical turning of zombies
fact: Calmer successfully turns the zombies in the southern hallway, buying the party a minute to investigate before fleeing.
source_quote: I wonder if Calmer has any power over the undead! And yes, he does! They are turned. We have about a minute to check out what’s here.

subject: Calmer’s dismissal from Village Elder meeting
fact: Calmer attempts to derail the Village Elder meeting by demanding the Prefect’s presence, but is shut down by Sequoia for being off-topic.
source_quote: “I would like to insist that the Prefect be present for these meetings.” ... “I don’t have time for this. Calmer, this is not the topic of the meeting.”

subject: Calmer’s failed healing attempt
fact: Calmer offers to help Derrick during his emotional breakdown, but is rebuffed due to his history of inappropriate interference.
source_quote: “I can help?” shouts Calmer. And I think, the last time he helped, he started berating someone about their life choices. “No, I think I can handle this.”

subject: claim of eliminating Snej
fact: Zinnia and Zephyr claim they eliminated Snej to prove loyalty.
source_quote: “We eliminated Snej. The abbey is ours to control, but we need reinforcements.”

subject: departure from moathouse
fact: The party escapes the moathouse after confronting the Ogre, zombies, and discovering prisoners, returning to Hommlet with survivors and artifacts.
source_quote: A few minutes later, we’re standing in front of the Duke, who is giving out food and talking to the merchants.

subject: departure from Village Elder house
fact: The party leaves the Village Elder house after being invited to the festival, with Sequoia and Zinia fleeing to avoid further obligations.
source_quote: Sequoia looks at me and Jaroo and says, “Gotta go!”

subject: Discovery of Lolth's Cult
fact: The party uncovered evidence of a recently active cult of Lolth, including a spider idol, human worshippers, a hidden lair, and a slain leader. This suggests Lolth is either trapped or weakened, contradicting her known status as a dormant deity. The cult’s presence indicates a resurgence or desperation in her followers.

subject: discovery of the Ogre's repast
fact: The party discovers that six prisoners were brought to the moathouse and consumed daily by the Ogre, with two merchants and a gnome spy surviving.
source_quote: Those captured alive were brought here as a repast for the Ogre. There were six of us. Every day, the Ogre would come in and take one of us.

subject: elimination of Snej
fact: Zinnia and Zephyr killed Snej, a worker of the water temple, as proof of their loyalty to the cult of fire. This act convinced Lareth to accept their defection.

subject: entering tower
fact: Zinia enters the tower near Emiry Meadows first.
source_quote: Straws are drawn, and I am going to enter first.

subject: festival invitation
fact: The Village Elders invite the party to participate in the end-of-month community festival, including decorating and location committee duties.
source_quote: Every month, we celebrate another month as a community. We wish people a happy birthday, celebrate any newborn, and mourn any deaths. ... Could you help with decorating? And could you participate in the location committee?

subject: festival invitation
fact: The village celebrates an end-of-month festival with birthdays, newborns, and mourning the dead.
source_quote: Every month, we celebrate another month as a community. We wish people a happy birthday, celebrate any newborn, and mourn any deaths.

subject: green slime attack
fact: A green slime drops from the arch and lands on Calmer.
source_quote: a blob of green slime lands on him.

subject: Jaroo’s agreement to present evidence
fact: Jaroo agrees to present the party’s evidence to the Village Elders the next day, marking the first official step toward institutional response.
source_quote: “Tomorrow then. We will meet at the Village Elder,” says Jaroo.

subject: Jarran’s offer to join
fact: The gnome spy Jarran offers to accompany the party if they promise to keep exploring, but is declined due to distrust.
source_quote: Although, if you need another sword and promise to keep exploring, I could stick around. ... No, I don’t think that’s necessary.

subject: Lareth accepts loyalty claim
fact: Lareth accepts their claim of eliminating Snej and rewards them with the promise of reinforcements.
source_quote: “Very good. You, indeed, have proven your loyalty. And I will reward you. And yes, let’s secure the abbey.”

subject: Lareth changes mission
fact: Lareth changes their mission from joining the abbey to retrieving a stolen chest.
source_quote: “No, wait. I have a better idea. Something that your obvious skills and talents are better suited to. A particular piece of art I am very fond of, a chest, was stolen. I would like it back.”

subject: Lareth confirms identity
fact: Lareth the Beautiful identifies himself to Zinnia and Zephyr.
source_quote: “I am Lareth. And who are you?”

subject: Lareth’s new mission assignment
fact: After accepting Zinnia and Zephyr’s loyalty, Lareth assigns them a new task: retrieve the stolen chest from the marauders in the Kron Hills near Sheernob, promising them control of the abbey in return.

subject: meeting with Druid
fact: The party meets with Jaroo the Druid in his grove to discuss the brigands and Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: The Druid meets us in his grove, his greybeard flowing, and listens to me...

subject: meeting with Village Elders
fact: The party attends a meeting with the Village Elder, Burne, Rufus, Jaroo, and Ostler to present evidence.
source_quote: I will be in the Village Elder's house—the same room where we met with him last time.

subject: meeting with Village Elders
fact: The party presents evidence to the Village Elders, who dismiss the threat of the Temple of Elemental Evil as insufficient for national action, and invite them to participate in the end-of-month festival.
source_quote: You have brought strong evidence of Brigand's activity... but not worthy of disrupting the arch-cleric of Verbobonc. ... You are invited, of course.

subject: Mephit Encounter
fact: Zephyr’s attempt to entertain a smoke and dust mephit with a sea-and-rain song backfired, triggering a rage response that led to the mephit’s death. The party learned that certain songs are lethally provocative to mephits—an unexpected hazard in magical environments.

subject: Narrator
fact: The mouse is shot by his allies, who then run away.
source_quote: The mouse just got shot by his allies, who are now running away.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator assesses the situation: captain and four mooks.
source_quote: There is a captain and four mooks.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator enters a room containing a filthy, cracked fountain that leaked onto the floor ages ago, leaving greenish stains.
source_quote: I enter a room containing a filthy, cracked fountain that leaked onto the floor ages ago, leaving greenish stains.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator groans in resignation.
source_quote: Fine.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator looks at Sequoia, who looks right back.
source_quote: I look at Sequoia, who looks right back at me.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator opens a small door in the corner of the room and finds the cultist’s leader.
source_quote: I walk quietly to it and open it. Inside is the cultist’s leader.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator performs a stakeout with Sequoia and Zephyr.
source_quote: A stakeout. I guess it could be worse.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator realizes the cultist is a worshipper of Lolth.
source_quote: Looking it over closely, I realize it must be Lolth. A human worshipper of Lolth.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator reflects on the complexity of agendas in the village.
source_quote: There are so many groups with different agendas. Do the traders work for the Duke? Does the Duke work for the traders? Is the Duke an independent agent? The layers and complexities of these conspiracies are surprising for such a small town.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator remembers a secret mission and chooses not to think about it.
source_quote: This reminds me of the time I was. Well, that’s a secret mission. And maybe I shouldn’t think about it.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator wants to find out who copied the map and starts at the workers' encampment near the fortress.
source_quote: I want to find out who copied the map. A good place to start is the workers' encampment near the fortress.

subject: Narrator
fact: The narrator wonders if the cultist’s reward from his infernal god will be everything he hoped for.
source_quote: I wonder if his reward from his infernal god will be everything he hoped for.

subject: ogre attack
fact: The ogre Lubash swings his club at the party upon encountering them.
source_quote: And it swings it’s club.

subject: ogre killed
fact: The party kills the ogre Lubash in the eastern room of the moathouse.
source_quote: With the dead carcass lying in the doorway, I enter carefully into the room beyond.

subject: opening of southern door
fact: The party opens the heavily barred southern door, revealing the prison cells that contained the zombies and the Ogre’s victims.
source_quote: And why is that door to the south so heavily barred? Calmer, who has recovered from being attacked by an ogre, and I clear the door.

subject: Ostler’s whisper about Jaroo
fact: Ostler whispers to Zinia that he is pleased she consulted Jaroo before outsiders, indicating local political alignment with the Druid’s authority.
source_quote: And I am very pleased that you decided to go to Jaroo before going to those interloping outsiders.

subject: prisoners freed
fact: The party frees the two merchants and the gnome spy from the eastern storeroom.
source_quote: “Who are you?” says a tired and frightened voice. ... “Let’s get you all outside.”

subject: rest before descending
fact: The party takes a brief rest before descending into the lower level of the moathouse.
source_quote: But first, a brief rest. It’s essential to rest when facing monsters.

subject: revelation of the Circle of Eight
fact: Spugnoir reveals that the Circle of Eight—legendary mages including Bigby, Ottiluke, and Leomund—appeared at the Battle of Emiry Meadows to bind an evil presence in the tower.
source_quote: There are tales that the circle of eight appeared. ... The Circle of Eight is neither good nor evil. They only care about the balance.

subject: Rufus
fact: Rufus dismissed the evidence of the Temple’s re-emergence as lacking national importance.
source_quote: We have no conclusive evidence of the re-emergence of the Temple of Elemental Evil.

subject: secret door discovery
fact: A secret door is discovered in the pillar of the torture room, leading to a shaft.
source_quote: He taps the pillar, and a door opens, 'The secret door.'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia and the group dump bodies into the river to hide evidence.
source_quote: We dumped them into the river, and hopefully, they wash up downriver where nobody will notice.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia announces the contents of the weapon room.
source_quote: 50 shields, 12 suits of leather armor, and several barrels of salted meat.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia calls for Calmer because they have ghouls.
source_quote: Calmer, get over here; we have ghouls.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia decided to meet with the Druid first before presenting evidence to the elders.
source_quote: We should go to the Druid first.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia describes the ghoul’s appearance in detail.
source_quote: Its withered body seems composed of little more than bruised skin stretched over sinew and bone, but its bulbous belly juts out and sloshes from side to side as it moves. Filth and gore stain its claw-like hands and wizened face. And eyes as black as pitch weep a tarry substance, which a black tongue—slithering from its fanged mouth—licks from its cracked lips.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia marches down a north passage ending in a door.
source_quote: Sequoia looks down the passage heading 100 or more feet north from the room with the crayfish, ending in a door, and marches down it.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia noticed the greased door hinges in the eastern storeroom.
source_quote: The door hinges are greased. For a place that should be abandoned, that’s odd.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia observes a splintered coffin with gnawed and split bones.
source_quote: The niche the secret door opened has a coffin that is splintered. Examining the coffin more carefully, he notices gnawed and split bones.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia pulled her swords upon hearing a bang, suspecting an ambush.
source_quote: I then overhear a bang. I pull my swords, ready to strike, and realize it’s the cleric.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia pursues the mouse from a distance as it heads toward the river.
source_quote: Sequoia is pursuing him from a distance as he leaves the encampment.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia says they can rest in the earthen tunnel.
source_quote: We can rest here and continue tomorrow.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia shouts, “Moat house.”
source_quote: Moat house," I shout.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia stands over the mouse’s body to protect him from the mooks.
source_quote: I need to stop that. I have to get really close to combat, stand over his body, and protect him.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia winces at the sound of Zephyr’s fists landing on a body.
source_quote: That has got to hurt. The sound of Zephyr’s fists landing on a body always hurt. I know I shouldn’t wince, and I don’t but I want to.

subject: smoke mephit killed
fact: The party kills the smoke mephit in the tower near Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: in a few moments, they are dead.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir is super excited about the scene of the dead cultists.
source_quote: Mon Dieu, this is amazing! This is incredible.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir looks at the narrator as if it's their job to find every secret door.
source_quote: He looks at me as if it’s my job to go through every secret door.

subject: Spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir shouts out the contents of the laboratory.
source_quote: Two potions of gaseous form. A potion of healing. And yes, look at this, a magical dagger!

subject: Spugnoir joins party
fact: Spugnoir joins the party as they leave the Village Elder's house and head to Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: Calmer and I followed, but he was slightly disappointed when we told him we were taking Spugnoir with us.

subject: Spugnoir’s presence at the tower
fact: Spugnoir accompanies the party to the tower, identifies the summoning circle, and contributes knowledge of the Circle of Eight, but remains passive during combat.
source_quote: Spugnoir, peaking over my shoulder, says, “It contains the formula for a magic circle.” ... “There was a great battle here some years ago...”

subject: Spugnoir’s writing at the inn
fact: Spugnoir is seen writing at his table in the Inn of the Welcome Wench, suggesting he is documenting the party’s activities or compiling his own research.
source_quote: He smiles and heads back to his table, where he seems busy writing stuff.

subject: Tort’s Ambush and Rescue
fact: Hestort Flintshine was shot by his own allies — the bandits — while fleeing the encampment. He was then rescued by Sequoia, Zephyr, and Zinnia, who healed him and began interrogation. The event triggered a chain of revelations about the Duke and hidden agendas.
source_quote: The mouse just got shot by his allies, who are now running away... Zephyr uncorks a potion of healing and feeds it to this mouse.

subject: travel to Hommlet
fact: They arrived in Hommlet.
source_quote: A bit later, we arrived in Hommlet.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: village meeting
fact: The Village Elder closes the meeting and invites the party to participate in end-of-month festival planning.
source_quote: The Village Elder closes the topic and lets us go unless we want to participate in the end-of-month festival planning.

subject: visit to the tower near Emiry Meadows
fact: The party enters a tower near Emiry Meadows, finds a summoning circle, a mural, and a smoke mephit, and kills it after Zephyr’s ill-advised song.
source_quote: Looking inside, I see permanent markings on the floor for a summoning circle and mural. ... The smoke mephit turns to us... Zephyr tries to entertain him with some song.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr approaches the narrator, suspicious and unimpressed.
source_quote: What the hells are you doing here?

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr chokes down a laugh when the cleric is attacked by the giant crayfish.
source_quote: Zephyr chokes down a laugh and then shouts, “Don’t lose the treasure.”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr declares the supplies could support an army or major brigand operation.
source_quote: There are enough supplies for an army or a major brigand operation.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr feeds a potion of healing to the wounded mouse.
source_quote: Zephyr uncorks a potion of healing and feeding it to this mouse.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr gives Calmer a mission to retrieve treasure from the pool.
source_quote: Calmer, I have a mission for you. ... So go get that treasure; just be quiet about it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr learned from Spugnoir about the Circle of Eight and their involvement in the Battle of Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: There are tales that the circle of eight appeared.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr mutters something that causes Tort to panic and pee himself.
source_quote: Zephyr looks into Tort’s eyes and mutters something. Now, Tort is peeing himself.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr observes the torture chamber and the undead that may have been prisoners for ten years.
source_quote: These poor souls may have been left here for 10 years and turned into zombies. I’ve heard of worse in the Abyss, but this is bad.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr opened the second door after Zinia noticed everyone staring at it.
source_quote: Finally, Zephyr gets the point and mutters, “I will open the door.”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr points out that the mouse is running.
source_quote: Zephyr points out that the mouse is running.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr removed the green slime from Calmer's armor using wood he was carrying.
source_quote: Using some wood I happened to be carrying on me, I removed the slime from his armor.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr reveals their intent was to kidnap, not save, the survivor.
source_quote: We need information. We’re not your saviors. We wanted to kidnap you, but they got to you first.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr sang a song that enraged the smoke mephit.
source_quote: Zephyr tries to entertain him with some song. Unfortunately, as we learn later, that song is a song that immediately induces a blood-curdling rage in smoke and dust mephits.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr spooks the man, who runs to his house.
source_quote: And I’ve spooked him. And a spooked mouse will run to its house.

subject: Zephyr’s reaction to the Village Elder meeting
fact: Zephyr describes the Village Elder meeting as worse than the Abyss, and is relieved when Sequoia and Zinia flee.
source_quote: I’ve seen the abyss. And let me assure you, the Abyss is not appreciably worse than that meeting.

subject: Zephyr’s song inciting mephit
fact: Zephyr sings a song about the sea, rain, and clear day after fire, which enrages the smoke mephit and triggers combat.
source_quote: Zephyr tries to entertain him with some song. Unfortunately, as we learn later, that song is a song that immediately induces a blood-curdling rage in smoke and dust mephits.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia declined to accompany Calmer to speak with the Cleric.
source_quote: I tell him to go. He’s disappointed I won’t follow.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia encountered a smoke mephit who demanded entertainment to avoid attack.
source_quote: The smoke mephit turns to us and says that if we entertain him, we won’t be attacked for entering his kingdom.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia entered the tower and discovered a summoning circle and mural.
source_quote: I see permanent markings on the floor for a summoning circle and mural.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia learned from Ostler that her room had been paid for until the 19th.
source_quote: And your room has been paid for until the 19th.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia observed that Ostler was pleased she went to Jaroo before outsiders.
source_quote: And I am very pleased that you decided to go to Jaroo before going to those interloping outsiders.

subject: Zinia
fact: Zinia witnessed Calmer attempt to derail the Village Elder meeting by demanding the Prefect’s presence.
source_quote: “I would like to insist that the Prefect be present for these meetings.”

subject: Zinia’s decision to enter tower first
fact: Zinia draws the straw to enter the tower first, demonstrating leadership and risk-taking despite Spugnoir’s caution.
source_quote: Straws are drawn, and I am going to enter first. The mage is as far back as possible.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia asks the survivor his name.
source_quote: What’s your name?

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia discovered the magical cloak of elvenkind in the Ogre’s nest.
source_quote: I look inside the Ogre’s nest and discover a magical cloak of elvenkind.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia grabs the robe and says they will wear them.
source_quote: We will wear these.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth describe the bandits as marauders pretending to be earth elemental cultists.
source_quote: Some bandits, marauders pretending to be earth elemental cultists, poseurs.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth order the Sergeant to help them.
source_quote: Go help them.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say he exudes evil.
source_quote: The beautiful man who exudes evil turns to the Sergeant

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say he has a better idea.
source_quote: No, wait. I have a better idea.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say he is Lareth.
source_quote: I am Lareth. And who are you?

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say he is fond of a particular chest.
source_quote: A particular piece of art I am very fond of, a chest, was stolen.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say he is very fond of the chest.
source_quote: a particular piece of art I am very fond of, a chest

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say he will let them join him.
source_quote: And yes, let’s secure the abbey.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say he will reward them.
source_quote: I will reward you.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say the abbey is theirs to control.
source_quote: The abbey is ours to control, but we need reinforcements.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say the abbey will be theirs if they return the chest.
source_quote: Bring me the chest, and the abbey will be yours.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say the bandits are marauders.
source_quote: Some bandits, marauders pretending to be earth elemental cultists, poseurs.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say the bandits are posing as earth elemental cultists.
source_quote: marauders pretending to be earth elemental cultists, poseurs.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say the chest is in the Kron Hills near Sheernob.
source_quote: I don’t know where they are besides the Kron Hills near Sheernob.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say the chest was stolen.
source_quote: a chest, was stolen.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say the water temple recruited them.
source_quote: The water temple recruited us.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say their skills are better suited to a particular task.
source_quote: Something that your obvious skills and talents are better suited to.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say they eliminated Snej.
source_quote: We eliminated Snej.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say they have proven their loyalty.
source_quote: You, indeed, have proven your loyalty.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say they noticed how efficient his team was.
source_quote: And we noticed how efficient your team was.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth say they saw how sloppy Snej was.
source_quote: But we saw how sloppy Snej was.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia hears Lareth shout his new command.
source_quote: No, wait. I have a better idea. Something that your obvious skills and talents are better suited to.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia holds her breath.
source_quote: Zinnia holds his breath.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia learned the identity of the gnome spy: Jarran.
source_quote: My name is Jarran.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia learned the names of the two merchant prisoners: Derrick and Florian.
source_quote: My name is Derrick, and this is Florian.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia listens as Lareth gives a new task.
source_quote: Bring me the chest, and the abbey will be yours.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia notices a peculiar gleam in Lareth’s eyes.
source_quote: But then Zinnia notices a peculiar gleam in Lareth’s eyes.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia notices a trail of blood leading to a pillar.
source_quote: A trail of blood catches his eye, disappearing in a pillar to the south.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia notices the locks and hinges on a door are new and oiled.
source_quote: The locks are new, and the hinges oiled. Someone has been here recently.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observes Lareth and sees that he believes them.
source_quote: Lareth does, “And why should I let you join me? What have you done for me?”

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realizes fresh air is wafting in from outside.
source_quote: He walks down the hallway and realizes fresh air is wafting in from outside.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia stares at the man.
source_quote: Zinnia stares at the man.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia suspects a secret door exists due to evidence of a commanding mind.
source_quote: There must be a secret door somewhere here. There is too much evidence of a mind that is in charge.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia taps the pillar and discovers a secret door.
source_quote: He taps the pillar, and a door opens, “The secret door.”

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia tries to kill the captain by throwing a spear at him.
source_quote: Now Zinia is trying to kill the Captain by throwing a spear at him.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia whispers about the shaft’s depth and new rungs.
source_quote: It’s about 30 feet deep, and rungs have been placed into the shaft.

subject: zombie encounter
fact: The party encounters multiple zombies and decides to retreat from the area.
source_quote: Time to get out of here,

subject: zombie outbreak in southern hallway
fact: Five prison doors in the southern hallway release zombies, prompting a panicked retreat after the party realizes all doors contain undead.
source_quote: The other three doors also have zombies! ... “Time to get out of here,” I shout.

subject: Zombie Purge in the Moathouse
fact: Calmer, the cleric of St. Cuthbert, used a divine command to purge zombies in the moathouse dungeon. All but one fled in terror, revealing his hidden power and suggesting he was deliberately withholding his abilities until necessary.
source_quote: By the Power of St. Cuthbert, BEGONE ZOMBIES!

subject: zombies emerge
fact: Zombies emerge from the rotten prison doors in the southern hallway of the moathouse.
source_quote: “Zombies!”

subject: zombies flee
fact: The party flees the southern hallway after more zombies emerge from the other prison doors.
source_quote: “Time to get out of here,” I shout. Zephyr’s like, “We can take them!” ... runs for the archway and the stairs that go up.

subject: zombies turned
fact: Calmer turns the zombies with his clerical power.
source_quote: I wonder if Calmer has any power over the undead! And yes, he does! They are turned.

subject: Brigands
fact: Brigands captured merchants Derrick and Florian on the road to Hommlet and delivered them to the moathouse as food for the Ogre. They are the original source of the prisoners and likely controlled access to the moathouse.
source_quote: Brigands captured us along the road to Hommlet.

subject: brigands
fact: The brigands are a group of marauders who gathered intelligence on Lareth and the abbey, including the location of the stolen chest. Erin Darkmoon was their leader, and they are referenced as the source of prior intelligence.

subject: Circle of Eight
fact: The Circle of Eight cares only about balance, not good or evil.
source_quote: The Circle of Eight is neither good nor evil. They only care about the balance.

subject: Circle of Eight
fact: The Circle of Eight consists of eight powerful mages: Moderkainenen, Bigby, Ottiluke, and Leomund.
source_quote: The circle of eight consists of the eight most powerful mages in the world - Moderkainenen, Bigby, Ottiluke, and Leomund.

subject: Circle of Eight
fact: The Circle of Eight intervened at the Battle of Emiry Meadows to bind an evil presence.
source_quote: They showed up at the battle at a crucial juncture when some artifact was being used. When the battle was over, they went to the Temple of Elemental Evil and cast powerful spells to bind some evil presence within.

subject: cult of fire
fact: The cult of fire is an organization whose members wear distinctive robes and operate the abbey under Lareth’s command. Zinnia and Zephyr claim membership to gain access, though their true origins lie with the water temple.

subject: cult of fire
fact: The cult of fire is an organized religious faction that controls the abbey and employs guards in red robes. It is in conflict with the water temple and seeks to expand its influence through deception and violence.
source_quote: guards wearing robes of the cult of fire ... We are members of the cult of fire.

subject: cult of fire
fact: Zinnia and Zephyr claim to be members of the cult of fire to gain access.
source_quote: We go through the doors. Remember, we are members of the cult of fire.

subject: Cult of Lolth
fact: A small, recently active cult devoted to Lolth, the Spider Queen, was operating in the area. The cultists were human, worshiped via a spider idol, and had a hidden lair containing a bedroom with gnome-scale furniture and three bedrolls. Their leader was slain by Zephyr, and their presence suggests Lolth may be trapped or weakened, as her absence has been noted in local rumors.

subject: Cult of Lolth
fact: The cult of Lolth, identified by a spider idol, was active in the laboratory where Spugnoir and the two cultists were slain. The cult’s leader, a human worshipper of Lolth, was killed by the party. The cult appears to be a remnant faction, as Lolth herself is believed to be trapped somewhere. Their operations are centered around magical experimentation and hidden chambers, suggesting they are preparing for her return.

subject: earth elemental cultists
fact: Bandits posing as earth elemental cultists stole Lareth's chest.
source_quote: Some bandits, marauders pretending to be earth elemental cultists, poseurs.

subject: earth elemental cultists
fact: Earth elemental cultists are marauders posing as cultists who stole a chest that Lareth the Beautiful now wants recovered.
source_quote: Some bandits, marauders pretending to be earth elemental cultists, poseurs.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple is a religious organization symbolized by black robes found in the moathouse dungeon. Its presence is ambiguous — either it is still active, or someone is impersonating it. The robes were taken by Zinnia for infiltration purposes, indicating the group is being used as a cover for clandestine operations, possibly linked to the Duke or the larger conspiracy in Hommlet.

subject: Lolth
fact: The cult belongs to Lolth, a spider idol, and the worshipper is human.
source_quote: I look them over to find out what cult they belong to. Well, that’s interesting; it's a spider idol. Looking it over closely, I realize it must be Lolth. A human worshipper of Lolth.

subject: Merchants of Lotrimil
fact: The merchants of Lotrimil sent Jarran to investigate brigands in the area.
source_quote: I was sent out here by the merchants of Lotrimil to investigate the brigands attacking this area.

subject: Merchants of Norwell
fact: Derrick and Florian are merchants from Norwell who were captured by brigands.
source_quote: We’re originally from Norwell. Brigands captured us along the road to Hommlet.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: Brigands are masquerading as members of the Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: Jaroo repeat what we told him. He pushes the narrative that brigands are masquerading as agents of the temple than they are agents of the temple.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: Brigands may be aligned with the Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: brigands who may or may not have been aligned with the Temple of Elemental Evil.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil is believed to have been the site of a powerful binding spell cast by the Circle of Eight.
source_quote: They showed up at the battle at a crucial juncture when some artifact was being used. When the battle was over, they went to the Temple of Elemental Evil and cast powerful spells to bind some evil presence within.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil is suspected of involvement with the brigands and the moathouse’s operations. However, no confirmed members of the Temple are present, and its direct role remains ambiguous.
source_quote: brigands who may or may not have been aligned with the Temple of Elemental Evil.

subject: The Bandits
fact: The Bandits are a group of five (one captain, four mooks) who ambushed and shot Hestort Flintshine. They appear to be acting independently but may be working for the Duke or another hidden power. Their sudden attack and subsequent flight suggest coordination or fear of exposure.
source_quote: The mouse just got shot by his allies, who are now running away... If I kill the mooks, the captain will run. If I kill the captain, the mooks will run.

subject: The Bandits
fact: The bandits are a small group led by a captain who ambushed and attempted to kill Hestort Flintshine. They appear to be working against the Duke’s interests, possibly as mercenaries or rogue agents. Their sudden attack and subsequent flight suggest they are not independent but part of a larger conflict. All were killed by the party during the river ambush.

subject: The Duke’s Network
fact: The Duke is a central, shadowy figure in Hommlet, employing Hestort Flintshine and likely collaborating with traders, bandits, and possibly the Fire Temple. He is not the ultimate master but a middle agent working for someone within the village. His operations include smuggling, treasure hoarding, and possibly magical experimentation. His true allegiance and goals remain hidden, making him a key node in a complex web of conspiracies.

subject: The Traders
fact: The Traders are a group in the village who offered to store the party’s belongings, suggesting ties to the Duke. Their loyalty is ambiguous — they may serve the Duke, be independent, or be manipulated by another faction. They are a key variable in the village’s web of conspiracies.
source_quote: The Duke is the guy the traders offered to help us take care of our stuff.

subject: The Traders
fact: The traders of Hommlet offered to store the party’s gear and are suspected of working with the Duke. Their true loyalty is unclear — they may be independent, under the Duke’s control, or part of a third faction. Zephyr and Zinnia suspect they are entangled in the same conspiracy as the Duke, making them a potential front for smuggling or magical artifact trafficking.

subject: water temple
fact: The water temple is a mortal enemy of the cult of fire and employed Snej.
source_quote: He worked for the water temple, mortal enemies of fire.

subject: water temple
fact: The water temple is the mortal enemy of the cult of fire. It employed Snej, whose incompetence led Zinnia’s group to eliminate him and defect.
source_quote: He worked for the water temple, mortal enemies of fire.

subject: water temple
fact: The water temple is the mortal enemy of the cult of fire. Zinnia and Zephyr were originally recruited by this faction, but they now seek to betray it by eliminating Snej and joining Lareth’s side.

subject: alchemy lab
fact: An alchemy lab within the laboratory.
source_quote: It’s a laboratory that includes an alchemy lab and a book of magical formulae.

subject: bandit captain and mooks
fact: A captain and four mooks who ambush and kill Hestort.
source_quote: There is a captain and four mooks.

subject: bandit location
fact: The stolen chest was taken by bandits in the Kron Hills near Sheernob.
source_quote: some bandits, marauders pretending to be earth elemental cultists, poseurs. I don’t know where they are besides the Kron Hills near Sheernob

subject: barracks area
fact: The barracks area has a door to the north.
source_quote: Zinnia follows Zephyr and the guard down the hallway and arrive in a barracks area with a door to the north.

subject: battered bedroom
fact: A battered bedroom with gnome-scale furniture, including a bed, dresser, chest of drawers, coal bin, and pot-bellied stove.
source_quote: It’s a battered bedroom with gnome-scale furniture, including a bed, dresser, chest of drawers, coal bin, and pot-bellied stove.

subject: battered bedroom
fact: The bedroom has gnome-scale furniture: a bed, dresser, chest of drawers, coal bin, and pot-bellied stove, all mildewy and damaged from neglect.
source_quote: With the cultist dead, I can look over the room. It’s a battered bedroom with gnome-scale furniture, including a bed, dresser, chest of drawers, coal bin, and pot-bellied stove. The furniture is mildewy and damaged from neglect.

subject: book of magical formulae
fact: A book of magical formulae within the laboratory.
source_quote: It’s a laboratory that includes an alchemy lab and a book of magical formulae.

subject: caldron, fire pit, rotting cupboards
fact: A cauldron, fire pit, and rotting cupboards full of moldy foods.
source_quote: a cauldron, fire pit, and rotting cupboards full of moldy foods.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a cleric of St. Cuthbert who helps fight zombies and ghouls.
source_quote: The cleric of St. Cuthbert walks into the hallway... Calmer, get over here; we have ghouls.

subject: cauldron
fact: The cauldron is part of the fountain's recent mending and water-pumping system.
source_quote: The fountain has recently been mended, and water is being pumped again—a cauldron, fire pit, and rotting cupboards full of moldy foods.

subject: crypt
fact: A crypt with empty niches, a splintered coffin, and four ghouls.
source_quote: It’s a crypt. Many of the niches are empty. The niche the secret door opened has a coffin that is splintered... There are four of them.

subject: crypt
fact: The crypt has empty niches, a splintered coffin with gnawed bones, and four ghouls.
source_quote: It’s a crypt. Many of the niches are empty. The niche the secret door opened has a coffin that is splintered. ... gnawed and split bones. ... four of them. ... withered body ... bulbous belly ... eyes as black as pitch ... black tongue.

subject: Cultist’s Lair
fact: A hidden lair beneath a tower, accessed via secret doors, containing a filthy, mended fountain with greenish stains, a small door leading to a bedroom with gnome-scale furniture (bed, dresser, chest, coal bin, stove), three bedrolls, and the remains of a dead cultist leader. The lair showed signs of recent habitation and ritual activity.

subject: cultist's lair
fact: A room containing the cultist’s leader, recently dead.
source_quote: Inside is the cultist’s leader. He’s not happy to see me.

subject: Druid's grove
fact: The Druid meets the party in his grove to discuss the brigands and Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: The Druid meets us in his grove, his greybeard flowing, and listens to me...

subject: Druid’s grove
fact: The Druid’s grove is where the party first presents their findings to Jaroo, who urges caution and agrees to bring the matter to the Village Elders.
source_quote: The Druid meets us in his grove, his greybeard flowing, and listens to me...

subject: Duke's location
fact: The party stands before the Duke, who is giving out food and talking to merchants.
source_quote: we're standing in front of the Duke, who is giving out food and talking to the merchants.

subject: eastern passageway
fact: A 100+ foot north passageway ending in a door, with a southeast branch.
source_quote: Sequoia looks down the passage heading 100 or more feet north from the room with the crayfish, ending in a door, and marches down it. About 30 feet from the door, he sees a southeast passageway and turns down it.

subject: Eastern Storeroom
fact: The eastern storeroom is where the Ogre lived and kept its nest. It contains a magical cloak of elvenkind and signs of recent habitation, contrasting with the rest of the abandoned moathouse.
source_quote: This place looks lived in. And there in the corner is where the Ogre lived.

subject: Emiry Meadows
fact: Emiry Meadows is the site of a past battle where the Circle of Eight appeared and where the tower with the summoning circle is located.
source_quote: The tower that the mage promised is more of a single building. It's not quite at the Battle of Emiry Meadows but near the battle of Emiry Meadows.

subject: Emiry Meadows
fact: The tower near Emiry Meadows contains a summoning circle and mural on its floor.
source_quote: Looking inside, I see permanent markings on the floor for a summoning circle and mural.

subject: encampment
fact: The workers' encampment near the fortress.
source_quote: A good place to start is the workers' encampment near the fortress.

subject: even smaller door
fact: An even smaller door is in the corner of the room.
source_quote: An even smaller door is in the corner of the room. I walk quietly to it and open it.

subject: filthy cracked fountain
fact: A filthy, cracked fountain that leaked onto the floor ages ago, leaving greenish stains.
source_quote: a filthy, cracked fountain that leaked onto the floor ages ago, leaving greenish stains.

subject: filthy, cracked fountain
fact: The fountain leaked onto the floor ages ago, leaving greenish stains, and has recently been mended with water being pumped again.
source_quote: I take a quick look and point it out to him. 'Very well.' He looks at me as if it’s my job to go through every secret door. I look at Sequoia, who looks right back at me. I groan, 'Fine.' Sneaking, I enter a room containing a filthy, cracked fountain that leaked onto the floor ages ago, leaving greenish stains. The fountain has recently been mended, and water is being pumped again—a cauldron, fire pit, and rotting cupboards full of moldy foods.

subject: fire pit
fact: The fire pit is part of the fountain's recent mending and water-pumping system.
source_quote: The fountain has recently been mended, and water is being pumped again—a cauldron, fire pit, and rotting cupboards full of moldy foods.

subject: fire temple
fact: The fire temple is either active or being faked.
source_quote: Either the Temple is alive and well, or someone is doing a fantastic job of faking it.

subject: fire temple room
fact: A room containing black robes that symbolize the fire temple.
source_quote: The room to the north contains even more weapons and black robes that symbolize the fire temple.

subject: forge
fact: The forge is in the far corner.
source_quote: And a forge in the far corner.

subject: forge in the far corner
fact: A forge located in the far corner.
source_quote: And a forge in the far corner.

subject: ghoul nest
fact: An earthen tunnel leading to the ghouls' nest.
source_quote: when he finds an earthen tunnel that leads to their nest

subject: giant pool
fact: A giant pool surrounded by bones, frigid, with a ledge holding a pin with a ruby and a small tube.
source_quote: At the end of the southern passageway is a giant pool... a pin with a ruby and a small tube.

subject: giant pool
fact: The giant pool is enlarged, frigid, surrounded by bones, and contains a pin with a ruby and a small tube.
source_quote: At the end of the southern passageway is a giant pool. He examines it a bit more carefully and realizes that it is enlarged. Around the pool are bones. And the place is frigid. ... some coin, and there in the water on a ledge is a pin with a ruby and a small tube.

subject: hallway
fact: Fresh air is wafting in from outside the hallway.
source_quote: He walks down the hallway and realizes fresh air is wafting in from outside.

subject: hallway length
fact: The hallway is 50 feet long and runs north-south.
source_quote: The hallway is 50 feet long and runs north-south.

subject: hallway length
fact: The passage continues for 60 feet and ends at another door.
source_quote: The passage continues for 60 feet and ends at another door.

subject: Hestort Flintshine
fact: Hestort Flintshine, also called Tort, is a five-foot-tall, thin man who works for Terjon and the Duke.
source_quote: Hestort is five feet tall and thin as a rail... I work for Terjon... I just work with the Duke.

subject: Hommelet road
fact: The road back to Hommlet is quiet.
source_quote: The road back to Hommlet is quiet.

subject: Hommlet
fact: Hommlet is a deceptively small village teeming with hidden factions: the Duke, traders, bandits, the Fire Temple, remnants of the Lolth cult, and possibly other unknown entities. Each group has conflicting agendas, and no one is trustworthy. The village is a nexus of conspiracy, where every interaction is layered with deception. The party’s arrival has exposed its fragile balance.

subject: Hommlet
fact: The group arrives in Hommlet.
source_quote: A bit later, we arrived in Hommlet.

subject: Hommlet
fact: The party arrived in Hommlet after their exploration. Spugnoir and Zinia expressed excitement. The town is now their base of operations, and the party is considering whether to rest or investigate the workers' encampment near the fortress to trace who copied the map.

subject: Inn of the Welcome Wench
fact: The Inn of the Welcome Wench is where Zinia meets Spugnoir and Ostler.
source_quote: So when we walk into the Inn of the Welcome Wench, the magic user Spugnoir seems particularly pleased that the cleric is not with us.

subject: Inn of the Welcome Wench
fact: The Inn of the Welcome Wench is where the party returns to Hommlet, where Spugnoir is pleased by the cleric’s absence and Ostler pays for their room.
source_quote: So when we walk into the Inn of the Welcome Wench, the magic user Spugnoir seems particularly pleased that the cleric is not with us.

subject: Kron Hills
fact: The stolen chest is believed to be in the Kron Hills near Sheernob.
source_quote: I don’t know where they are besides the Kron Hills near Sheernob.

subject: Kron Hills near Sheernob
fact: The Kron Hills near Sheernob are the only known location of the marauders who stole the chest. This is the destination Lareth assigns to Zinnia and Zephyr for their new mission.

subject: Kron Hills near Sheernob
fact: The Kron Hills near Sheernob is the only known location where the bandits who stole the chest may be found, according to Lareth the Beautiful.
source_quote: I don’t know where they are besides the Kron Hills near Sheernob.

subject: laboratory
fact: A laboratory that includes an alchemy lab and a book of magical formulae.
source_quote: It’s a laboratory that includes an alchemy lab and a book of magical formulae.

subject: Laboratory
fact: A room adjacent to the tower, containing an alchemy lab, a book of magical formulae, shelves of moldering books, a forge in the corner, and the bodies of two slain cultists. It held the potions, dagger, and spellbook recovered by the party.

subject: laboratory
fact: Spugnoir shouts in the laboratory about two potions of gaseous form, a potion of healing, and a magical dagger.
source_quote: He walks to the laboratory and shouts, 'Two potions of gaseous form. A potion of healing. And yes, look at this, a magical dagger!'

subject: Laboratory with Alchemy Lab and Forge
fact: A hidden laboratory containing an alchemy lab, forge, and shelf of moldering books served as the base for the Lolth cult. It housed magical formulae, a secret door, and the remains of two slain cultists. Spugnoir discovered two potions of gaseous form, a healing potion, and a magical dagger here. The forge and alchemical equipment suggest active magical experimentation, possibly to empower Lolth’s return.

subject: Lolth
fact: Lolth has been gone for a while and is believed to be trapped somewhere.
source_quote: Lolth has been gone for a while. The scuttlebucket is that she’s trapped somewhere.

subject: moat house
fact: The moat house dungeon contains a hallway with zombies, cells, a torture chamber, and a room with green slime.
source_quote: A bit later, in the moathouse dungeon. ... To the east of this hallway are cells from where the zombies fled. To the west, he notices a torture chamber. ... They look old and broken. ... They encountered some green slime.

subject: moat house
fact: The moat house where Calmer performs his clerical duties and the party explores further.
source_quote: Moat house," I shout.

subject: moathouse
fact: The moathouse contains a great hall, staircase, lower levels, prison doors, a storeroom, an eastern door, a southern hallway with three pillars, five rotting prison doors, and a tower near Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: There is no doubt that some evil powers are here. And I will defeat them! But first, a brief rest. It’s essential to rest when facing monsters. Back in Verbobonc, one of the trainers argued that rest, not activity, builds strength.

subject: moathouse dungeon
fact: The moathouse dungeon contains a hallway with zombies, cells, a torture chamber, and a secret shaft.
source_quote: A bit later, in the moathouse dungeon.

subject: Moathouse Dungeon
fact: The moathouse dungeon is a multi-level underground complex used for torture, imprisonment, and necromantic rites. It contains zombie-infested halls, a torture chamber with a hidden secret door, a crypt with ghouls, a pool with a giant crayfish, and storage rooms filled with weapons, salted meat, and Fire Temple robes. Evidence of recent activity — oiled hinges, new rungs, and fresh blood — indicates an ongoing operation tied to the Duke and possibly the Fire Temple.

subject: moathouse eastern storeroom
fact: The eastern room of the lower level has greased door hinges and an ogre's nest.
source_quote: The door hinges are greased... I look inside the Ogre’s nest and discover a magical cloak of elvenkind.

subject: moathouse lower level
fact: The lower level of the moathouse contains a staircase next to the great hall.
source_quote: A staircase is next to the great hall, where we faced brigands who may or may not have been aligned with the Temple of Elemental Evil.

subject: moathouse lower level
fact: The lower level of the moathouse has a storage area with torn sacks, broken barrels, and shattered weapons racks.
source_quote: There are a few torn sacks, broken barrels, and shattered weapons racks. This was once a storage place and armory for the fortress.

subject: Moathouse Lower Levels
fact: The lower levels of the moathouse contain a great hall, stairwell, storage rooms, prison doors, and a southern hallway with five rotten prison doors. It was once an armory and storage facility for a fortress, now overrun with monsters and the remains of victims.
source_quote: This was once a storage place and armory for the fortress.

subject: moathouse southern hallway
fact: The southern hallway is 50 feet long with three pillars 20 feet apart and a passageway leading east.
source_quote: The hallway is 50 feet long and runs north-south. Three pillars are 20 feet apart, and a passageway leads east.

subject: moathouse western prison doors
fact: Five prison-like doors on the western wall of the southern hallway are rotten and no longer functional.
source_quote: Five doors are on the western wall. They look like they haven’t been opened in a long time. Something like prison doors designed to keep people in. Well, those doors are so rotten that they won’t keep anyone in anymore.

subject: ogre's nest
fact: The ogre's nest is in the corner of the eastern storeroom and contains a magical cloak of elvenkind.
source_quote: I look inside the Ogre’s nest and discover a magical cloak of elvenkind.

subject: passageway
fact: The passageway goes east beyond the door.
source_quote: Beyond the door is a passageway going east.

subject: passageway to east
fact: The passageway leads to a T intersection.
source_quote: From the crypts, a passageway leads east to a T intersection.

subject: River Encampment
fact: The river encampment near the fortress is where Hestort Flintshine was employed and where the party first attempted to extract information. It became the site of a failed kidnapping, a bandit ambush, and the shooting of Tort. The area is now a focal point of suspicion, with Sequoia and Zinnia conducting a stakeout. Its proximity to the river and the fortress suggests it is a logistical hub for smuggling or communication.

subject: river north of encampment
fact: The river north of the encampment where bandits ambush Hestort.
source_quote: He’s heading towards the river north of the encampment.

subject: secret door
fact: Spugnoir mutters that there is a secret door somewhere.
source_quote: Spugnoir looks around, frustrated, and mutters, 'There is a secret door somewhere.'

subject: secret door
fact: The secret door opens into a 30-foot-deep shaft with rungs.
source_quote: He taps the pillar, and a door opens, 'The secret door.' Opening it, he sees a shaft going down. He looks down and whispers, 'It’s about 30 feet deep, and rungs have been placed into the shaft.'

subject: secret door on other side
fact: A second secret door at the end of the passageway beyond the shaft.
source_quote: At the end of the passage is another secret door, 'Secret on the other side,' he mutters.

subject: secret door somewhere
fact: There is a secret door somewhere.
source_quote: There is a secret door somewhere.

subject: secret shaft
fact: A 30-foot-deep shaft with new rungs leading to a passageway and another secret door.
source_quote: It’s about 30 feet deep, and rungs have been placed into the shaft... The shaft down is narrow and then opens into a passageway. At the end of the passage is another secret door.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is a stealthy explorer who discovers hidden rooms, doors, and crypts.
source_quote: Sequoia squeezes through the opening... Sequoia shouts, 'Let’s check out the rooms near the stairway...' Sequoia looks down the passage...

subject: Sheernob
fact: Sheernob is a location near the Kron Hills where the stolen chest may be.
source_quote: I don’t know where they are besides the Kron Hills near Sheernob.

subject: shelf of moldering books
fact: A shelf of moldering books.
source_quote: There’s a shelf of moldering books.

subject: southeast passageway
fact: The southeast passageway leads 100+ feet north to a door.
source_quote: Sequoia looks down the passage heading 100 or more feet north from the room with the crayfish, ending in a door, and marches down it. About 30 feet from the door, he sees a southeast passageway and turns down it.

subject: Southern Hallway
fact: A 50-foot-long north-south hallway with three pillars and a passageway to the east. Five prison doors line the western wall, all rotten and broken, leading to the discovery of zombies.
source_quote: Five doors are on the western wall. They look like they haven’t been opened in a long time.

subject: southern hallway
fact: The southern hallway is 50 feet long, runs north-south, has three pillars 20 feet apart, a passageway leading east, and five rotten prison doors on the western wall.
source_quote: The hallway is 50 feet long and runs north-south. Three pillars are 20 feet apart, and a passageway leads east. Five doors are on the western wall. They look like they haven’t been opened in a long time. Something like prison doors designed to keep people in.

subject: spider idol
fact: The spider idol is Lolth.
source_quote: a human worshipper of Lolth. Looking it over closely, I realize it must be Lolth.

subject: spider idol room
fact: A room with a spider idol identified as Lolth.
source_quote: a human worshipper of Lolth. Looking it over closely, I realize it must be Lolth.

subject: splintered coffin
fact: A splintered coffin in the crypt with gnawed and split bones.
source_quote: The niche the secret door opened has a coffin that is splintered... gnawed and split bones.

subject: spugnoir
fact: Spugnoir walks over the bodies, bleeding out, and is super excited.
source_quote: Spugnoir walks over their bodies bleeding out on the ground and is super excited

subject: Terjon
fact: Terjon is the employer of Hestort Flintshine.
source_quote: I work for Terjon.

subject: the abbey
fact: The abbey is the stronghold controlled by Lareth the Beautiful and the cult of fire. It contains barracks, hallways, and a northern door leading to the barracks area. It is the target of Zinnia and Zephyr’s infiltration and the proposed reward for their loyalty.

subject: the abbey
fact: The abbey is the stronghold controlled by Lareth the Beautiful and the cult of fire. It contains barracks, multiple doors, and passageways. Zinnia’s group seeks to take control of it.
source_quote: The abbey is ours to control, but we need reinforcements. ... And yes, let’s secure the abbey.

subject: the Abyss
fact: The Abyss is referenced as a place of worse horrors than the moathouse.
source_quote: I’ve heard of worse in the Abyss, but this is bad.

subject: the crypt
fact: The crypt is a location with ghouls and an earthen tunnel leading to their nest.
source_quote: It’s a crypt... we can rest here and continue tomorrow.

subject: the Duke
fact: The Duke is a shadowy figure working with shady people and possibly traders.
source_quote: I just work with the Duke... The Duke is the guy the traders offered to help us take care of our stuff.

subject: the ghoul nest
fact: An earthen tunnel leading to the ghouls' nest.
source_quote: when he finds an earthen tunnel that leads to their nest

subject: the giant pool
fact: The giant pool is a frigid location with bones and a treasure on a ledge.
source_quote: At the end of the southern passageway is a giant pool... a pin with a ruby and a small tube.

subject: the moat house
fact: The moat house is a dungeon location with zombies, cells, a torture chamber, and hidden passages.
source_quote: A bit later, in the moathouse dungeon.

subject: The Moathouse Dungeon
fact: The moathouse dungeon is a site of previous zombie attacks and now serves as the next investigative target. It is a place of hidden threats and divine intervention, where Calmer’s true power is revealed.
source_quote: Alright, Calmer, do your thing... [then] BEGONE ZOMBIES!

subject: the passageway
fact: A passageway leads from the giant pool to a door and a southeast branch.
source_quote: Sequoia looks down the passage heading 100 or more feet north from the room with the crayfish, ending in a door, and marches down it. About 30 feet from the door, he sees a southeast passageway and turns down it.

subject: the river
fact: The river north of the encampment is where Hestort is ambushed and killed.
source_quote: He’s heading towards the river north of the encampment.

subject: The River North of the Encampment
fact: The river is a key transit point where Hestort was shot and where the party later dumped the bandits’ bodies. It serves as a route for escape, concealment, and disposal, and is now a symbolic boundary between safety and danger.
source_quote: He’s heading towards the river north of the encampment... We dumped them into the river, and hopefully, they wash up downriver where nobody will notice.

subject: the second secret door
fact: A second secret door at the end of the passageway beyond the shaft.
source_quote: At the end of the passage is another secret door, 'Secret on the other side,' he mutters.

subject: the secret door
fact: A secret door is hidden in the pillar of the torture room.
source_quote: He taps the pillar, and a door opens, 'The secret door.'

subject: the shaft
fact: A 30-foot-deep shaft with new rungs leads to a passageway and another secret door.
source_quote: It’s about 30 feet deep, and rungs have been placed into the shaft... The shaft down is narrow and then opens into a passageway. At the end of the passage is another secret door.

subject: the splintered coffin
fact: A splintered coffin in the crypt with gnawed and split bones.
source_quote: The niche the secret door opened has a coffin that is splintered... gnawed and split bones.

subject: torture chamber
fact: A torture chamber with recently used devices and a blood trail to a secret door.
source_quote: Torture room... These torture devices have been used very recently indeed.

subject: torture room
fact: A torture room with recently used devices and a blood trail leading to a secret door.
source_quote: Torture room... These torture devices have been used very recently indeed.

subject: torture room
fact: The torture room has recently used torture devices and a trail of blood leading to a secret door.
source_quote: The place seems long abandoned, covered in dust and cobwebs. ... these skeletons are not that old. And these torture devices have been used very recently indeed. ... a trail of blood, 'Gotcha.' ... disappearing in a pillar to the south.

subject: Tower
fact: A single building, not a grand tower as promised, located near the Battle of Emiry Meadows. It contained a summoning circle marked on the floor, a mural, and a mephit-occupied chamber. It served as the entry point to the cultist’s hidden lair.

subject: two cultists
fact: Two cultists who attack and die.
source_quote: And two cultists. They attack. They die.

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: Village Elder's house
fact: The Village Elder's house is the location of the meeting with Burne, Rufus, Jaroo, and Ostler.
source_quote: I will be in the Village Elder's house—the same room where we met with him last time.

subject: Village Elder's house
fact: The Village Elder's house is the site of a formal meeting where the party presents evidence, faces bureaucratic dismissal, and is invited to a festival.
source_quote: I will be in the Village Elder's house—the same room where we met with him last time.

subject: workers' encampment
fact: The workers' encampment is near the fortress.
source_quote: I want to find out who copied the map. A good place to start is the workers' encampment near the fortress.

subject: workers' encampment
fact: The workers' encampment near the fortress where Hestort Flintshine works.
source_quote: A good place to start is the workers' encampment near the fortress.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is a tactician who uses intimidation, potions, and strategy to extract information and secure treasure.
source_quote: Zephyr uncorks a potion of healing... Zephyr chokes down a laugh... Zephyr turns to me...

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia gets the magical dagger.
source_quote: fair is fair, and Zinnia gets it.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a spy who discovers secret doors, blood trails, and hidden passageways.
source_quote: Zinnia smiles... Zinnia taps the pillar... Zinnia grabs the robe...

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: Cultists
fact: Two cultists of Lolth attacked Zephyr in a laboratory. They were swiftly killed. Their bodies were found with bloodied clothing and signs of recent activity. A third, higher-ranking cultist was later slain by Zephyr in a hidden chamber.

subject: dust mephit
fact: A dust mephit is present alongside the smoke mephit in the tower, though only the smoke mephit is directly interacted with.
source_quote: What concerns me is a dust and smoke mephit.

subject: Ghouls
fact: Four ghouls were encountered in the moathouse crypt, identified by their withered, bloated bodies, tarry weeping eyes, and fanged mouths. They were drawn to the crypt by the remains of the dead and were partially driven off by Calmer’s holy symbol. They are linked to the torture chamber, suggesting victims were left to be consumed. Their nest lies in an earthen tunnel beneath the crypt, indicating a sustained presence.

subject: Giant Crayfish
fact: A giant crayfish inhabits a frigid pool in the moathouse dungeon, surrounded by bones and a hidden treasure ledge. It attacked Calmer when he attempted to retrieve a ruby pin and small tube. The creature is unusually cold-adapted, suggesting magical or planar influence. It was defeated after a coordinated assault by Sequoia and Zephyr.

subject: green slime
fact: A blob of green slime hangs over the arch at the bottom of the stairwell in the moathouse.
source_quote: I noticed, just in time, the blob of green slime hanging over the arch at the bottom of the stairwell.

subject: Green Slime
fact: A green slime encountered in the stairwell of the moathouse that consumed Calmer’s armor. It is a hazardous ooze that dissolves organic and metallic materials upon contact.
source_quote: the blob of green slime hanging over the arch at the bottom of the stairwell.

subject: green slime
fact: The green slime lands on Calmer and eats through his armor.
source_quote: a blob of green slime lands on him. And he starts squealing... the slime ate through it.

subject: marauders posing as earth elemental cultists
fact: These marauders are bandits pretending to be earth elemental cultists. They stole a chest that Lareth is very fond of and are believed to be hiding in the Kron Hills near Sheernob.

subject: ogre
fact: An ogre named Lubash attacks the party at the eastern door of the moathouse.
source_quote: Standing at the now-open eastern door is an ogre. “You are not members of the temple! You are food!” And it swings it’s club.

subject: ogre
fact: The ogre Lubash is killed by the party in the eastern room of the moathouse.
source_quote: With the dead carcass lying in the doorway, I enter carefully into the room beyond.

subject: Smoke and Dust Mephit
fact: A solitary smoke and dust mephit inhabited a tower chamber, claiming the space as its kingdom. It offered non-aggression in exchange for entertainment. It was killed after Zephyr played a sea-and-rain song that induced a blood-curdling rage in mephits—an unexpected and fatal misjudgment.

subject: smoke mephit
fact: A smoke mephit inhabits the tower near Emiry Meadows and demands entertainment.
source_quote: I notice everyone is staring at me and at another door. I stare back. Finally, Zephyr gets the point and mutters, “I will open the door.”

subject: smoke mephit
fact: A smoke mephit inhabits the tower near Emiry Meadows, demands entertainment to avoid attack, and is killed after Zephyr sings a song that enrages it.
source_quote: What concerns me is a dust and smoke mephit. The smoke mephit turns to us and says that if we entertain him, we won’t be attacked for entering his kingdom.

subject: smoke mephit
fact: The smoke mephit is killed by the party after Zephyr sings a song that angers it.
source_quote: Zephyr tries to entertain him with some song... that song is a song that immediately induces a blood-curdling rage in smoke and dust mephits... in a few moments, they are dead.

subject: Snej
fact: Snej was a humanoid operative of the water temple who was killed by Zinnia’s group as proof of loyalty to the cult of fire. He is now dead and used as a narrative tool.
source_quote: We eliminated Snej. The abbey is ours to control, but we need reinforcements.

subject: zombie
fact: There are at least three zombies in the first cell.
source_quote: There were more zombies in that cell.

subject: zombie
fact: Zombies are behind all three other doors in the area.
source_quote: The other three doors also have zombies!

subject: zombie
fact: Zombies are not contained by the doors in the cell, which fail to keep them inside.
source_quote: Remember those doors that won't keep anyone inside? Well, they aren't keeping those zombies inside the cell.

subject: zombie
fact: Zombies are present in all five prison cells along the western wall of the southern hallway.
source_quote: “The other three doors also have zombies!”

subject: zombie
fact: Zombies emerge from the rotten prison doors in the southern hallway of the moathouse.
source_quote: “Zombies!”... they aren’t saying anything. But what happens is the sound that escapes from their decaying vocal cords sounds like “nsazsa,” and everyone thinks they are saying Brains!”

subject: zombie
