subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr pursued animated potatoes, captured them with a knife, stuffed them into a bag, and later consumed one, describing it as more filling than a captured rat. Zephyr later participated in the infiltration of the Black Earth Cult encampment and observed the failed bluff by Calmer.
source_quote: Bouncing potatoes,” I shout to Seqoia and run after them... I grab one, and the other two pause as if angry... I stab the one in my hand... The potato is in my belly. And I feel blessed.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, "You served me well, potato. And you were certainly more filling than that rat I caught in that prison."
source_quote: "You served me well, potato. And you were certainly more filling than that rat I caught in that prison."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia delivered a barrel of mead to the Honey Tavern Inn and interacted with Glannon, who offered a keg of magical mead that enhances charisma and persuasion. Zinnia suspected mockery but accepted the gift. Zinnia later observed and reacted to clues about the Black Earth Cult with a momentary flash of pleasure when the trail became clear.
source_quote: You found it? Yes. He rolls the barrel behind the bar, and takes out a keg, 'Here’s my fine keg of mead... The magic in the mead will help when you need to interact with people and persuade them.'

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a combatant who delivers a flurry of blows against the bandits, contributing significantly to their rapid elimination during the battle.
source_quote: Zinnia follows, just laying into the bandits with some serious force. Flurry of blows, he calls it, multiple attacks, and the bandits are dropping like flies.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is inscrutable but reveals a momentary flash of pleasure when hearing about the Black Earth Cult and the box Lareth wants.
source_quote: I look at Zinnia, and although he is inscrutable, even his eyes reveal a momentary flash of pleasure.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia shows a momentary flash of pleasure upon hearing about the Black Earth Cult.
source_quote: I look at Zinnia, and although he is inscrutable, even his eyes reveal a momentary flash of pleasure.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia thanked Glannon.
source_quote: I thank him.

subject: animated broccoli
fact: An enchanted vegetable that became animated and fled the feast, heading toward the apothecary. It was eventually struck with a spell and collapsed into a dark green substance, suggesting it was a vessel or byproduct of the Black Earth Cult’s magic.
source_quote: It took off like a shot towards the apothecary... I pick up the 'broccoli' now just a very dark green something...

subject: animated broccoli
fact: The animated broccoli took off toward the apothecary, and was later reduced to a very dark green something after being struck.
source_quote: It took off like a shot towards the apothecary, that place with all the magical potions and stuff. I pick up the "broccoli" now just a very dark green something and go back to the honey tavern.

subject: animated potatoes
fact: Animated potatoes were chased, grabbed, stabbed, and later consumed in a honey-glazed forest stew.
source_quote: I grab one, and the other two pause as if angry. So I take my knife and stab the one in my hand. And a few hours later, the potato is in my belly. And I feel blessed. The honey-glazed forest stew feels like a blessing indeed.

subject: animated potatoes
fact: Three animated potatoes that escaped the feast, causing chaos in the village. One was stabbed and consumed by Zephyr, while the others were captured and bagged. Their animation suggests the cult’s ability to imbue mundane objects with life.
source_quote: Bouncing potatoes... I grab one, and the other two pause as if angry... I stab the one in my hand... The potato is in my belly.

subject: barrel
fact: Zinnia carries a barrel to the Honey Tavern Inn.
source_quote: With the barrel over my shoulder I arrive at the Honey Tavern Inn.

subject: barrels
fact: The barrels in the encampment are the same ones that were taken from the caravan and are now held by the cult.
source_quote: Inside the walls is a temple to some god, a weird stone statue, as well the barrels that we are looking for.

subject: dark green substance
fact: The collapsed broccoli became a very dark green something.
source_quote: I pick up the “broccoli” now just a very dark green something

subject: glowing runes
fact: Faintly glowing magical runes etched into rocks at the caravan attack site, indicating the use of high-level enchantment or ritual magic. Their presence confirmed the attack was not banditry but the work of the Black Earth Cult.
source_quote: faintly glowing runes etched into the rocks... I shout, 'Magic.'

subject: honey jars
fact: Honey jars were scattered at the caravan site, indicating the stolen cargo.
source_quote: The site is littered with overturned wagons, broken barrels, and scattered honey jars.

subject: keg of mead
fact: Glannon gives Zinnia a keg of mead with magical properties.
source_quote: Here’s my fine keg of mead.

subject: keg of mead
fact: The magic in the mead helps with persuasion and attracting attention.
source_quote: The magic in the mead will help when you need to interact with people and persuade them.

subject: magical mead keg
fact: A keg of mead imbued with magic that enhances charisma, persuasion, and the ability to 'turn heads' or 'convince merchants.' Offered by Glannon at the Honey Tavern Inn as a tool for social manipulation, possibly linked to the cult’s broader enchantment practices.
source_quote: Here’s my fine keg of mead... The magic in the mead will help when you need to interact with people and persuade them.

subject: mud men
fact: Mud men were summoned beside Calmer and exploded upon defeat, creating area-of-effect immobilization.
source_quote: Suddenly two muddy creatures appear right beside Calmer. Mud men. ... When these mud men go down, they kind of explode, make it so you can’t move.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: stone golem
fact: The stone golem is large, tough, resistant to non-magical attacks, and was summoned by Thalsor during the battle.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam! – it comes alive. Stone Golem, they call it. Big, tough, and resistant to everything but magical attacks.

subject: stone object
fact: A mysterious stone object, possibly a focus or artifact, is tapped by Thalsor to summon the stone golem. It is integral to his ability to deploy powerful constructs.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam! – it comes alive.

subject: stone staff
fact: Thalsor wields a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals, which channels his magic and causes runes on the cavern walls to flare with ominous light.
source_quote: his hands tightening around a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals... the runes on the walls flare with an ominous light.

subject: stone staff with jagged crystals
fact: Thalsor wields a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals, which activates runes on the walls during combat.
source_quote: I watch as he steps forward, his hands tightening around a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals.

subject: stone-studded leather armor
fact: The cultists wear stone-studded leather armor and carry stone weapons.
source_quote: The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons.

subject: stone weapons
fact: The cultists carry stone weapons, indicating their connection to the Black Earth Cult and the Earth Mother.
source_quote: The guardian are wearing stone-studded leather armor and carrying stone weapons.

subject: Black Earth Cult's identity
fact: The party suspects the Black Earth Cult is responsible for the caravan attack and may possess the box Lareth wants.
source_quote: This might be the clue and evidence we need. It certainly is who Lareth wants us to kill, and they might have this box that Lareth wants.

subject: Lareth’s target
fact: Lareth has tasked the party with identifying and eliminating the Black Earth Cult, believed to be responsible for the caravan attack and possibly possessing a box he desires. The cult’s use of stone weapons and chanting confirms they are the intended target, though their full motives remain unclear.
source_quote: This might be the clue and evidence we need. It certainly is who Lareth wants us to kill, and they might have this box that Lareth wants.

subject: mysterious falling rocks
fact: The party nearly got crushed by falling rocks while following the trail to the cult encampment. Though no culprits were found, the timing suggests possible manipulation by the cult to deter pursuers, hinting at deeper earth-based magic or sentience.
source_quote: We almost get crushed by falling rocks... I am worried that the stones were not an accident, but we find nothing.

subject: Palsmarie Clee's presence
fact: It is unclear whether Palsmarie Clee walked into the Inn or was always there.
source_quote: Has she walked into the Inn, or was she always there?

subject: Thalsor’s true identity
fact: Thalsor’s name and origins are uncertain — referred to as 'whatever his name is' — suggesting he may be an alias or a figure with hidden history.
source_quote: This druid, Thalsor, whatever his name is...

subject: the honey
fact: The honey is the central object of Thalsor’s obsession and the reason for his hostility. He refuses to surrender it and offers to trade instead, suggesting deeper lore or magical significance.
source_quote: That honey now belongs to the Black Earth Temple... Offers to trade, anything but giving up the honey.

subject: The identity of the attackers
fact: The identity of the attackers is unknown, though Palsmarie Clee suspects they are not bandits.
source_quote: I don’t know. Gnonsbim says they are bandits. I don’t think so.

subject: The location of the Black Earth Temple
fact: The exact location of the Black Earth Temple is not yet known, though the encampment in the Kron Hills is suspected.
source_quote: It’s built into a shallow cave on a rocky outcrop in the Kron Hills.

subject: The nature of the Stone Golem
fact: The nature and origin of the Stone Golem conjured by Thalsor are unexplained.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam – it comes alive. Stone Golem, they call it.

subject: The origin of the animated vegetables
fact: The origin of the animated broccoli and potatoes is unexplained.
source_quote: some of the ingredients were animated and they rushed into the village.

subject: the stone golem’s origin
fact: The stone golem’s creation via a simple stone tap implies it may be bound, ancient, or magically linked to the location or Thalsor’s power source — its true nature is unexplained.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam! – it comes alive.

subject: after collecting the honey reward in Sheernobb
fact: The party's arrival in Ostverk followed their collection of the honey reward in Sheernobb and their encounter with religious zeal in Hommlet, where Zinnia surrendered a magical trident.
source_quote: After collecting the honey reward in Sheernobb and enduring the religious zeal of Calmer in Hommlet, where Zinnia gave up a perfectly good magical trident...

subject: after the chaos of the Moathouse and the Kron Hills
fact: The journey to Ostverk occurred after the chaotic events at the Moathouse and the Kron Hills, marking a period of relative calm for the party.
source_quote: The journey to Ostverk was uneventful, a welcome change after the chaos of the Moathouse and the Kron Hills.

subject: elapsed time
fact: All night Thalsor has described in detail what he intends to do the body if we don’t show up in the morning.
source_quote: All night Thalsor has described in detail what he intends to do the body if we don’t show up in the morning.

subject: Planting 23, 579
fact: The battle against Thalsor and the death of Calmer occurred on Planting 23, 579, marking the start of the party’s urgent mission to recover the body and plan retaliation.

subject: Planting 24, 579
fact: On Planting 24, 579, the party executed their infiltration plan, killed Thalsor, retrieved Calmer’s body, and discovered the monastery notes, shifting the campaign’s direction.

subject: session date
fact: The events continue on Planting 24, 579.
source_quote: ### Planting 23, 579

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 23rd day of Planting, 579.
source_quote: Planting 23, 579

subject: Battle at Zephyr’s compound
fact: A deadly confrontation occurred where Thalsor killed Calmer, defeated healers, and held the body for ransom; the party’s counterattack using gaseous form resulted in Thalsor’s death and the retrieval of the corpse.

subject: Battle of Emiry Meadows
fact: The Battle of Emiry Meadows was a past conflict in which Robert Deakin fought, giving him credibility in his assertion that the 'big evil power' rumors were merely bandits and that the Temple was destroyed.
source_quote: He claimed to know because he had fought in the Battle of Emiry Meadows.

subject: body integrity
fact: Calmer’s dead body is on the ground. Intact. It can be raised.
source_quote: Calmer’s dead body is on the ground. Intact. It can be raised.

subject: Calmer's death consequence
fact: Without Calmer’s spells we can’t kill the golem, so we focus on killing Thalsor.
source_quote: Without Calmer’s spells we can’t kill the golem, so we focus on killing Thalsor.

subject: cultist identification
fact: These were not some random bandits. Lareth said some random bandits stole a chest. These are cultists of earth. We just solved a problem for him.
source_quote: These were not some random bandits. Lareth said some random bandits stole a chest. These are cultists of earth. We just solved a problem for him.

subject: Discovery of monastery notes
fact: After the battle, notes were found revealing the chest’s location in a mountain monastery, shifting the party’s focus from immediate survival to long-term strategic objectives.

subject: Elimination of Black Earth Cult presence
fact: The party eliminated Thalsor and his mud mephit servant, dismantling the Black Earth Cult’s local presence and fulfilling Lareth’s hidden agenda to weaken rival elemental factions.

subject: faction manipulation
fact: The various elemental factions are at each other’s throats. Lareth wants to get rid of the competition. He sent us here to get rid of his enemies. We just made him more powerful.
source_quote: The various elemental factions are at each other’s throats. Lareth wants to get rid of the competition. He sent us here to get rid of his enemies. We just made him more powerful.

subject: Gonnathrad Kevanarial's offer
fact: Gonnathrad Kevanarial offered to write a five-page backstory for our adventure.
source_quote: he almost divulged information about the monastery before recalling his actual duty... offering to write a five-page backstory for us

subject: healing restriction
fact: Jaroo reiterated the importance of securing the chest, noting that the Terjon might withhold healing magic from non-followers.
source_quote: Jaroo... noting that the Terjon might withhold healing magic from non-followers

subject: party's exit from Ostverk
fact: The party exited Ostverk as quickly as possible to minimize attention, having obtained the confirmed location of the abandoned monastery and the letter of permit, and now intent on following the lead.

subject: Resurrection of Calmer
fact: Calmer’s resurrection was made possible by offering a magical trident as a tithe to Terjon at the Temple of St. Cuthbert, despite the temple’s prior reluctance to aid non-followers.

subject: Rithelm Drake's recollection
fact: Rithelm Drake recalled an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner.
source_quote: he eventually recalled an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner

subject: rumor about big evil power
fact: Deakin was adamant that rumors of a 'big evil power' were lies, insisting they were merely bandits.
source_quote: Deakin, however, was adamant that rumors of a 'big evil power' were lies, insisting they were merely bandits.

subject: rumor about chest
fact: Local chatter confirmed that a powerful chest had indeed been lost to bandits, and many were searching for it.
source_quote: The local chatter confirmed that a powerful chest had indeed been lost to bandits, and many were searching for it.

subject: rumor about Clee family connection
fact: Deakin mentioned he was related to the Clee family (our honey purveyors in Sheernobb) and even had honey mead from the Honey Tavern Inn.
source_quote: Deakin mentioned he was related to the Clee family (our honey purveyors in Sheernobb) and even had honey mead from the Honey Tavern Inn.

subject: rumor about elf payment
fact: The elves at Caer Ostverk and Lord Denelu were willing to pay well for information on the chest's location.
source_quote: It was also rumored that the elves at Caer Ostverk and Lord Denelu were willing to pay well for information on the chest's location.

subject: rumor about treaty with Celene
fact: The chest's true purpose was to secure a treaty with the Kingdom of Celene, to wage war on the gnomes and seize their gem mines.
source_quote: The chest's true purpose was to secure a treaty with the Kingdom of Celene. The Viscounty (Verbobonc) intended to use this alliance to wage war on the gnomes and seize their gem mines.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia encountered Gonnathrad Kevanarial, a High Elf Diplomat who wanted to be a quest giver.
source_quote: Gonnathrad Kevanarial, a High Elf Diplomat... became overly excited at the prospect of being a "quest giver"

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia learned from Rithelm Drake that an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner was the likely location of the chest.
source_quote: he eventually recalled an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia materialized, grabbed Calmer’s body, and ran.
source_quote: Sequoia materializes, grabs calmer’s body and runs.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia received a letter of permit from Gonnathrad Kevanarial, officially hiring them to pursue the chest near Gallow's Corner.
source_quote: he issued us a letter of permit, officially hiring us to pursue a lead regarding the chest near a monastery by Gallow's Corner

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia stared at Calmer’s wounds and said they would act tomorrow.
source_quote: Sequoia stares at his wounds, "Tomorrow."

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia was promised 100 gold pieces upon presenting the letter to Caer Ostverk.
source_quote: It promised 100 gold pieces as a reward when presented to Caer Ostverk.

subject: Sequoia's plan
fact: Sequoia stares at his wounds, 'Tomorrow.'
source_quote: Sequoia stares at his wounds, 'Tomorrow.'

subject: tavern keeper demand
fact: The tavern keeper, Robert Deakin, insisted we purchase food before he’d talk.
source_quote: the tavern keeper, Robert Deakin, a gnome, insisted we purchase food before he’d talk

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor screamed his plans to kill, mutilate, and destroy, promising retribution of earth and evil.
source_quote: Thalsor screams his plans to kill and mutilate and destroy and promises the retribution of earth and evil

subject: Thalsor's compound
fact: Thalsor is not coming out of his compound. He’s wounded too. And he doesn’t want to die.
source_quote: Thalsor is not coming out of his compound. He’s wounded too. And he doesn’t want to die.

subject: Thalsor's threat
fact: Thalsor needs to die.
source_quote: Thalsor needs to die.

subject: the battle at the compound
fact: The battle at the compound is referenced by Zinnia as the event in which Thalsor killed Calmer, was defeated by the party using gaseous form potions and close-range attacks, and resulted in the retrieval of Calmer’s body, the honey, and the notes.
source_quote: Sequoia materializes, grabs Calmer’s body and runs. Thalsor is shocked. Without Calmer’s spells we can’t kill the golem, so we focus on killing Thalsor. The surprise worked. My attacks and Zephyr’s attacks strike him down quickly.

subject: the confirmation of Lareth’s manipulation
fact: The confirmation of Lareth’s manipulation is referenced by Zinnia as the realization that their actions served Lareth’s goal of eliminating rival factions to increase his own power.
source_quote: We just made him more powerful.

subject: the decision to pursue the monastery
fact: The decision to pursue the monastery is referenced by Sequoia as the new objective formed after recovering the notes from Thalsor’s compound and confirming the location with Rithelm Drake.
source_quote: Our primary objective was to follow the lead we’d uncovered regarding the lost chest's location in a monastery.

subject: the defeat of the mud mephit
fact: The defeat of the mud mephit is referenced by Zinnia as the final act after Thalsor’s death, completing the elimination of all threats in the compound.
source_quote: Only a mud mephit remains and we kill that too.

subject: the gathering of rumors at The Cheap Forester
fact: The gathering of rumors at The Cheap Forester is referenced by Zinnia as the event where information about the chest, the Battle of Emiry Meadows, the Viscounty’s plans, and the Clee family connection was confirmed.
source_quote: While consuming our mandatory meal, I keenly observed the rumors circulating...

subject: the issuance of the letter of permit by Gonnathrad Kevanarial
fact: The issuance of the letter of permit by Gonnathrad Kevanarial is referenced by Sequoia as the event that officially hired the party to pursue the chest near Gallow’s Corner, promising 100 gold pieces from Caer Ostverk.
source_quote: he actually gave us a letter of permit, officially hiring us to pursue a lead regarding the chest near a monastery by Gallow's Corner... promising 100 gold pieces as a reward when presented to Caer Ostverk.

subject: the journey to Ostverk
fact: The journey to Ostverk is referenced by Sequoia as the uneventful trip following the battle at the compound, undertaken to pursue the monastery lead.
source_quote: The journey to Ostverk was uneventful, a welcome change after the chaos of the Moathouse and the Kron Hills.

subject: the killing of Thalsor
fact: The killing of Thalsor is referenced by Zinnia as the decisive outcome of the battle, eliminating the threat and enabling the party to secure their objectives.
source_quote: My attacks and Zephyr’s attacks strike him down quickly.

subject: the night of Thalsor’s threats
fact: The night of Thalsor’s threats is referenced by Zinnia as the period during which Thalsor detailed his intended desecration of Calmer’s body, forcing the party to plan their infiltration.
source_quote: All night Thalsor has described in detail what he intends to do the body if we don’t show up in the morning.

subject: the plan to use gaseous form potions
fact: The plan to use gaseous form potions is referenced by Zinnia as the strategy devised to infiltrate the compound without detection, executed successfully by Sequoia.
source_quote: So we intend to use potions of gaseous form to sneak in and then attack from close range.

subject: the retrieval of Calmer’s body
fact: The retrieval of Calmer’s body is referenced by Zinnia as the critical success of the infiltration, enabling his potential resurrection.
source_quote: Sequoia materializes, grabs Calmer’s body and runs.

subject: the return of the honey to Pasmarie Clee
fact: The return of the honey to Pasmarie Clee is referenced by Zinnia as the event where the reward was received, and where Robert Deakin confirmed his familial connection to the Clee family.
source_quote: The first stop was to Pasmarie Clee in Sheernobb, where we returned her honey and received our reward.

subject: the silence after the battle
fact: The silence after the battle is referenced by Zinnia as the moment following the deaths of Thalsor and the mud mephit, when Calmer’s body lay intact on the ground.
source_quote: Silence. Calmer’s dead body is on the ground. Intact. It can be raised.

subject: the tithe of the magical trident to Terjon
fact: The tithe of the magical trident to Terjon is referenced by Zinnia as the event that enabled Calmer’s revival, though it was emotionally difficult and noted as a pragmatic sacrifice.
source_quote: I made the difficult decision to give up a magical trident, offering it as a tithe to Terjon at the Temple of St. Cuthbert.

subject: the use of early morning fog as cover
fact: The use of early morning fog as cover is referenced by Zinnia as the environmental advantage exploited during the infiltration of the compound.
source_quote: I’ll use the early morning fog as cover.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: use of early morning fog as cover
fact: I’ll use the early morning fog as cover.
source_quote: I’ll use the early morning fog as cover.

subject: use of gaseous form potions
fact: We intend to use potions of gaseous form to sneak in and then attack from close range.
source_quote: So we intend to use potions of gaseous form to sneak in and then attack from close range.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr attempted to retrieve Calmer’s body but was interrupted by Thalsor.
source_quote: And then just as I was about to get Calmer’s body, Thalsor killed him.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr learned from Rithelm Drake that he had once considered being an adventurer but settled for family life.
source_quote: he lamented that he'd once considered being an adventurer himself before settling down with a wife and three kids.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr learned from Robert Deakin that the talk of 'big evil powers' was a cover for bandits.
source_quote: Deakin, though, had his own theories, arguing that the talk of "big evil powers" was just a cover for bandits

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr looked around after the battle and turned to Zinnia to say the attackers were cultists.
source_quote: Zephyr is looking around and turns to me and says, "These were not some random bandits. Lareth said some random bandits stole a chest. These are cultists of earth."

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr received a letter of permit from Gonnathrad Kevanarial, officially hiring them to pursue the chest near Gallow's Corner.
source_quote: he actually gave us a letter of permit... officially hiring us to pursue the chest near the monastery at Gallow's Corner

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr saved Sequoia and Zinnia after they were knocked out.
source_quote: I saved Sequoia and Zinnia.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr shouted to Thalsor that they would negotiate tomorrow.
source_quote: Zephyr shouts, "We’ll negotiate tomorrow, Thalsor."

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr took a position to attack Thalsor with bows during the assault.
source_quote: Zephyr will take a position where he can attack with bows.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr was eager to leave Ostverk quickly to avoid drawing attention to his appearance.
source_quote: I, for one, was eager to leave Ostverk as quickly as possible. In a town full of people with agendas, the less attention drawn to us, the better, especially with my appearance.

subject: Zephyr's departure motive
fact: I, for one, was eager to leave Ostverk as quickly as possible.
source_quote: I, for one, was eager to leave Ostverk as quickly as possible.

subject: Zephyr's negotiation
fact: Zephyr shouts, 'We’ll negotiate tomorrow, Thalsor.'
source_quote: Zephyr shouts, 'We’ll negotiate tomorrow, Thalsor.'

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia concluded that Thalsor must die to prevent exposure of their identities to the cult.
source_quote: Thalsor needs to die.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia confirmed Calmer’s body was intact and could be raised.
source_quote: Calmer’s dead body is on the ground. Intact. It can be raised.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia gave up a magical trident as a tithe to Terjon to revive Calmer.
source_quote: I made the difficult decision to give up a magical trident, offering it as a tithe to Terjon at the Temple of St. Cuthbert

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia learned Robert Deakin was related to the Clee family.
source_quote: Deakin mentioned he was related to the Clee family (our honey purveyors in Sheernobb)

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia learned from Robert Deakin that the chest’s true purpose was to secure a treaty with Celene to wage war on the gnomes.
source_quote: He unveiled a fascinating theory: the chest's true purpose was to secure a treaty with the Kingdom of Celene. The Viscounty (Verbobonc) intended to use this alliance to wage war on the gnomes and seize their gem mines.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia learned that the elves at Caer Ostverk and Lord Denelu were willing to pay for information on the chest’s location.
source_quote: It was also rumored that the elves at Caer Ostverk and Lord Denelu were willing to pay well for information on the chest's location.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia looked at Zephyr and realized Lareth had manipulated them to eliminate rivals.
source_quote: I look at him and it clicks, "The various elemental factions are at each other’s throats. Lareth wants to get rid of the competition. He sent us here to get rid of his enemies. We just made him more powerful."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia noted that the golem was immobile after Thalsor’s death.
source_quote: The golem is immobile.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed Sequoia gliding toward Calmer’s corpse using a potion of gaseous form.
source_quote: Sequoia has taken position with his potion of gaseous form. He glides towards Calmer’s corpse.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed that Thalsor was wounded and unwilling to leave his compound.
source_quote: He’s wounded too. And he doesn’t want to die.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realized that without Calmer’s spells, they could not kill the golem and shifted focus to killing Thalsor.
source_quote: Without Calmer’s spells we can’t kill the golem, so we focus on killing Thalsor.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia recognized that Thalsor intended to mutilate Calmer’s body to prevent resurrection.
source_quote: The bastard will mutilate the body, making it impossible to raise him from the dead.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia secured notes indicating the lost chest was located in a monastery within the mountains.
source_quote: we secured the stolen honey from Pasmarie Clee and, crucially, found notes indicating the lost chest was located in a monastery within the mountains

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia struck Thalsor during the surprise attack, helping to kill him quickly.
source_quote: My attacks and Zephyr’s attacks strike him down quickly.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia visited Jaroo, who warned that Terjon’s followers might withhold healing from non-followers.
source_quote: We also made sure to visit Jaroo, who reiterated the importance of securing the chest, noting that the Terjon (implied to be followers of St. Cuthbert like Terjon) might withhold healing magic from non-followers.

subject: Zinnia's conclusion
fact: Our plan was reckless and the price was the death of Calmer.
source_quote: Our plan was reckless and the price was the death of Calmer.

subject: Zinnia's perspective

subject: Circle of the Scarlet Moon
fact: The Circle of the Scarlet Moon is a group presented as a druidic order but is in fact a front for the Fire Temple. Jaroo and others suspect it of being overly showy and religious rather than natural, and it is associated with the Hall of the Scarlet Moon and the rite of the wicker giant.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple is a cult of elemental evil, disguised as the Hall of the Scarlet Moon. It is led by robed figures who identify themselves as circuits of the Scarlet Moon and worship fire, water, earth, and air. They launched devastating magical attacks against the party and were responsible for knocking Calmer unconscious.
source_quote: The party immediately realized they had been set up by Captain Tolub, who had sent them to the Fire Temple instead of the Earth Temple. As they attempted to flee, the fire priests unleashed devastating magical attacks, hurling explosive bursts of flame that severely wounded the party and knocked Calmer unconscious.

subject: Elemental Evil in the Kron Hills
fact: The presence of the Fire Temple disguised as a druidic order in the Kron Hills suggests a broader infiltration of elemental evil into natural spiritual traditions. The party’s encounter confirms this threat, but its full scope and origin remain unknown.

subject: Madame Selentis’s Shadow

subject: Misdirection by Captain Tolub
fact: Captain Tolub deliberately misled the party by directing them to the Fire Temple under the guise of the Hall of the Scarlet Moon, betraying their trust and nearly resulting in their deaths. This deception remains unresolved and may indicate deeper corruption within the region’s leadership.
source_quote: The party immediately realized they had been set up by Captain Tolub, who had sent them to the Fire Temple instead of the Earth Temple.

subject: Serena’s Rescue and the Five Hundred Gold
fact: The party was credited with five hundred gold pieces for Serena’s rescue — the same amount they paid for her release — suggesting a possible entrapment or orchestrated scheme. The source of the payment and its true purpose remain unclear.
source_quote: The party also discovered they had been credited with five hundred gold pieces for Serena’s rescue, the same amount they had paid for her release.

subject: The Iron Lash
fact: The Iron Lash is more than a brothel—it is a nexus of human trafficking, debt slavery, and occult control in Nulb, tied to Madame Selentis and the Crimson Reapers; its true nature remains a looming threat.
source_quote: Eryk laughed, 'It was simply the name of the local brothel.'—but the party knew better.

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil

subject: Temple of Elemental Evil
fact: The Temple of Elemental Evil loomed as a massive structure far larger than imagined, with a ruined tower jutting from the northeast corner of shattered walls, standing like a leprous gray monument to darkness, its arched buttresses obscene and covered in climbing vegetation, every surface carved with leering faces and writhing forms depicting unspeakable obscenities, with a pervading sense of fear hanging over it like a tangible cloud of vileness, sounds distorted, movements flickering at the edges of vision, the wind moaning through hundreds of apertures like the wails of doomed souls, ravens croaking among the ruins, and the main entrance featuring two pairs of massive bronze doors twenty-three feet high and twenty feet wide, held fast by huge iron chains with all cracks sealed, graven with glowing runes that burned with silvery radiance.
source_quote: The Temple of Elemental Evil loomed before them, a massive structure far larger than they had imagined. A ruined tower jutted from the northeast corner of shattered walls, and the temple itself stood like a leprous gray monument to darkness. Its arched buttresses were obscene, covered in climbing vegetation, and every surface was carved with leering faces and writhing forms depicting unspeakable obscenities. A pervading sense of fear hung over the entire area like a tangible cloud of vileness. Sounds seemed distorted, and movements flickered at the edges of their vision. The wind moaned through hundreds of apertures in the temple walls, creating sounds like the wails of doomed souls, while ravens croaked and flapped among the ruins. The main entrance featured two pairs of massive bronze doors, twenty-three feet high and twenty feet wide, held fast by huge iron chains with all cracks sealed. Graven upon these doors were glowing runes that burned with silvery radiance, making their eyes water to look upon.

subject: ghasts
fact: Two ghasts were engaged after the ghoul battle; one emitted a poisonous stench that weakened Calmer; one was killed by Sequioa; the other was slain by Zephyr's pistol shot after being weakened by Calmer's spectral guardians and Zinnia's strike.
source_quote: The party turned their attention to the two ghasts they had encountered earlier. Calmer suggested a tactical approach, pre-casting his spectral guardians before engaging the creatures. He opened the door to the ghast chamber, and the undead threatened the party, declaring they would be nothing but food. Calmer, emboldened by their recent victories over twenty ghouls, retorted that the last ghouls had said the same thing. He invoked his spectral guardians, and the divine magic immediately began tearing into the ghasts. One of the creatures emitted a poisonous stench that overcame Calmer, weakening him, but the party pressed their advantage. Zinnia entered the chamber and struck one of the ghasts, then tactically withdrew from the poisonous aura, though the movement provoked a retaliatory strike that wounded him. He resisted the creature's paralyzing touch through sheer fortitude. Sequioa charged the other ghast, his attacks finding their mark repeatedly until the creature fell. He then disengaged, avoiding the remaining ghast's stench. The surviving ghast attacked Calmer but missed, and Calmer's spectral guardians continued their relentless assault. Finally, Zephyr drew his pistol and fired, the shot echoing through the chamber as it struck the ghast and ended its unnatural existence.

subject: ghouls

source_quote: Following a passageway to the south, Sequioa opened a door and immediately encountered several ghouls—mindless undead creatures with no allegiance to any temple, only to their insatiable hunger. Calmer confirmed what the party suspected: these creatures served no master but their own bellies. The ghouls attacked without hesitation, and the party responded in kind. Zinnia struck the first ghoul with brutal efficiency, while Sequioa killed one creature outright and wounded another. Zephyr, utilizing his assassin's training, dispatched two ghouls in rapid succession. One ghoul, sensing the tide turning against it, disengaged and fled into an adjacent chamber. The remaining ghouls pressed their attack, one charging Zephyr but missing, another striking Sequioa with claws and teeth, and a third lunging at Zinnia but failing to connect. Calmer invoked powerful magic, summoning spectral guardians that tore through the undead, and all three nearby ghouls succumbed to the divine assault.

The battle with the snake was swift but intense. Zephyr struck first with his short sword, wounding the creature as it lunged at him with venomous fangs but missed. Zinnia joined the fray, her attacks landing with devastating precision. Calmer invoked dark magic against the serpent, though it initially resisted his spell. Sequioa, despite some initial difficulty, managed to wound the creature further. The snake, desperate and hungry, continued its assault on Sequioa but failed to connect. Calmer's second invocation proved more effective, and finally Zinnia delivered a killing blow that left the snake lifeless on the kitchen floor.

subject: Deep Temple
fact: The Deep Temple is referenced as the former employer of Romag’s predecessor, and its influence is blamed for the undead's refusal to serve Romag and the Earth Temple. It is implied to be a rival power structure with opposing ideological control over undead entities.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple claimed dominion over the harpies' lair and the ghasts' territory after the party falsely declared allegiance to it. The ghasts, though insincere, swore allegiance to the temple for survival, effectively making the area a subsidiary holding under its banner. The temple's leadership, represented by Romag, operates on a system where agents must deliver treasure and pay a portion, not receive payment.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple is portrayed as a hierarchy that grants titles and ranks in exchange for loyalty, and employs ritualistic sacrifices of prisoners to an earthen god, though its ghast followers appear to be performing hollow allegiance.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The party accepted this arrangement, effectively claiming the ghasts' territory as a subsidiary holding under the Earth Temple's banner.
source_quote: The party accepted this arrangement, effectively claiming the ghasts' territory as a subsidiary holding under the Earth Temple's banner.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The party fabricated affiliation with the Earth Temple to gain temporary control over the ghasts' territory, and the ghasts accepted the fiction without resistance, indicating willingness to cooperate under false pretenses.
source_quote: The party claims to work for the Earth Temple... The ghasts immediately declare allegiance to the Earth Temple... An insight check reveals the ghasts are willing to go along with the fiction.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple is implied to be the scapegoat for the disappearance of prisoners previously freed by the party, potentially triggering political conflict with the Earth Temple.

subject: The wraith’s behavior
fact: The wraith of the Air Temple did not attack the party — it let them pass — suggesting it may be bound to the temple’s ignorance or acting as a passive symbol of its decay.
source_quote: The spectral guardian began drifting toward them... turned back into the darkness.

subject: The Wraith's Purpose
fact: The wraith of the Air Temple does not attack — it waits, and turns back when its domain is left. Its behavior suggests it is not hostile, but territorial — and the party has learned to avoid it rather than fight.
source_quote: The spectral guardian began drifting toward them as they moved through the dim corridors. Rather than engage it, the party ran, and the wraith, seemingly satisfied once they had fled its domain, turned back into the darkness.

subject: three-way war
fact: The party conspired to ignite a three-way war between the Earth, Fire, and Water Temples, aiming to destroy all three factions from within by manipulating their rivalries and power vacuums.

source_quote: Hartsch makes clear he would consider himself worthy of leadership if a position were to open.

subject: After the Second Level Descent
fact: The events described occurred immediately after the party’s descent into the second level corridors, following a failed short rest and the re-encounter with the wraith — marking a critical turning point in the war where chaos transitions from battlefield to subterranean conspiracy.
source_quote: The second level hit different the moment we reached it.

subject: disengagement
fact: The team initiated disengagement immediately after mission success, recognizing the kill zone had become indiscriminate.
source_quote: Time to not be here anymore... You're exiting the kill zone you personally created before it becomes indiscriminate about its victims.

subject: mission completion
fact: The mission was accomplished in the narrowest operational sense: barricade broken, advance resumed, factions engaged in mutual destruction.
source_quote: The mission was accomplished in the narrowest operational sense: the barricade broken, the advance resumed, the fire and earth factions in the process of tearing into each other exactly as intended.

subject: session date
fact: The events described occurred during a single, continuous descent through the temple levels — a session marked by escalating tension, silent victories, and the slow realization that the party was not the hunters, but the hunted.

subject: Session Date
fact: The events described occurred during the same operational window — the temple war’s critical phase — immediately following the breach of the barricade and preceding the party’s disengagement, with no time for rest or recovery.

subject: session date
fact: The events occur during a session of the temple war, following the cleric’s prior death and resurrection, and before any resolution to the undead threat.
source_quote: I have been killed once already in this gods-forsaken temple, revived at considerable cost...

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs during the descent into the second level corridors and subsequent events, with no explicit calendar date provided.

subject: Session Time — Before Morning
fact: The events unfold under pressure of an impending deadline — 'before morning' — which frames all decisions. Time is scarce, and the party must choose between completing tasks, freeing prisoners, and acquiring intelligence.
source_quote: I thought about how many locks I still had to pick tonight, and what we still needed to do before morning.

subject: the current day
fact: The party's actions occur before morning, implying the current day is ongoing.
source_quote: I thought about how many locks I still had to pick tonight, and what we still needed to do before morning

subject: Barricade Breach
fact: The barricade at the choke point was breached not by force, but by eliminating its hinge — the frontline cultist — followed by Calmer’s divine radiance that destroyed the double doors entirely, triggering the collapse of the Fire Temple’s defensive line and the onset of factional chaos.

subject: barricade destroyed
fact: The barricade is destroyed when the double doors fly open.
source_quote: They flew open with the kind of finality that makes everyone on both sides pause for half a breath.

subject: Barricade Destruction
fact: The barricade was destroyed by Calmer’s divine radiance, triggering the collapse of the Fire Temple’s defensive line and enabling the Earth Temple advance.
source_quote: The double doors at the barricade simply *stopped existing as an obstacle*. They flew open with the kind of finality that makes everyone on both sides pause for half a breath.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer realized his divine light had no effect on the wraith.
source_quote: The holy light dissolved into the cold air like breath in winter, leaving exactly nothing behind.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer thought, 'This is not fair,' though he recognized it lacked theological dignity.
source_quote: This is not fair, I thought, which is not a thought with a great deal of theological dignity, but it was the honest one.

subject: Calmer is struck by fire bolt
fact: A stray bolt of fire adds insult to Calmer’s injury as he clears the threshold.
source_quote: and then a stray bolt of fire from somewhere in the chaos added its own insult on top

subject: Calmer is struck by wraith
fact: The wraith reaches out and catches Calmer across the back with a cold, deep blow.
source_quote: The wraith reached out as I sprinted and caught me across the back. A blow that cost something real, cold and deep,

subject: Calmer revived
fact: Calmer was revived at considerable cost by someone who claims not to care about him.
source_quote: I have been killed once already in this gods-forsaken temple, revived at considerable cost to someone who claims not to care about me

subject: Calmer's breathing returning to normal
fact: Calmer's breathing slowly returned to something resembling normal.
source_quote: The sounds of Calmer's breathing slowly returned to something resembling normal.

subject: Calmer's divine attempts on wraith
fact: Calmer made two attempts to use divine power against the wraith, both of which failed.
source_quote: Two attempts. Two failures.

subject: Calmer's Divine Outburst
fact: Calmer experienced an uncontrolled eruption of divine power — a visible, audible surge of holy wrath that overwhelmed three remaining ghouls, causing them to flee in terror — an event that broke the expected pattern of cleric combat and suggested a deeper, possibly corrupted, connection to his deity.
source_quote: The holy wrath came out of him like something that had been stored under pressure for weeks. It hit the room — all three remaining ghouls unable to hold against it, every last one of them — and they *fled*.

subject: Calmer's divine radiance
fact: Calmer releases a pulse of guiding radiance that causes the double doors at the barricade to stop existing as an obstacle.
source_quote: A single pulse of guiding radiance, the kind of divine light that doesn't ask permission, and the double doors at the barricade simply *stopped existing as an obstacle*.

subject: Calmer unleashes divine power on ghouls
fact: Calmer releases divine power that causes the three remaining ghouls to flee in terror.
source_quote: Calmer let the undead have it. The holy wrath came out of him like something that had been stored under pressure for weeks. It hit the room — all three remaining ghouls unable to hold against it, every last one of them — and they *fled*.

subject: Cleric’s Final Escape
fact: The cleric was struck from behind by the wraith, received a secondary fire bolt injury, but escaped through the passage and survived.
source_quote: The wraith reached out as I sprinted and caught me across the back... a stray bolt of fire from somewhere in the chaos added its own insult... I cleared the threshold. I made it through the passage. I was, technically, alive.

subject: Cultist Neutralization
fact: A cultist at the front of the Fire Temple line was swiftly eliminated by direct assault, removing the hinge of the barricade and initiating the tactical collapse.
source_quote: Through the steam, into the billowing white heat, and then just — strikes, a sequence of controlled impacts... The cultist dropped before the bugbears had finished processing that we were there.

subject: Divine Failure Against Wraith
fact: Calmer’s two consecutive, fully powered divine interventions against the wraith failed utterly — holy light dissolving into nothing — marking an unprecedented event in which a cleric of St. Cuthbert’s power was rendered impotent by an undead entity, shattering theological expectations.

subject: door movement sequence
fact: The door opened and closed again while the party was distracted by the elemental battle.
source_quote: This one opened on its own. Just: open, when it had been closed a moment before. Then closed again.

subject: Elemental Battle in the Hall
fact: The sustained elemental conflict between fire snakes and water gargoyles created a self-sustaining veil of steam and noise, enabling the party to move unseen through the Hall of Trophies.

subject: escape sequence
fact: The party slips away south during the elemental battle using steam for cover.
source_quote: We moved between the billows, staying low, staying quiet, letting the heat swallow the sound of our passage.

subject: Ghoul Ambush
fact: A group of four ghoulized Earth Temple members ambushed the party in a corridor, bypassing a prematurely triggered trap and forcing the party into close combat.
source_quote: They came out of the dark... hit it before it was ready. The mechanism failed at the worst possible moment... the ghouls kept coming.

subject: he
fact: He gestured for the others to follow and started walking.
source_quote: He gestured for the others to follow and started walking.

subject: he
fact: He let the runner see him receiving the message calmly.
source_quote: He let the runner see him receiving the message calmly.

subject: he
fact: He thought to himself, 'This again.'
source_quote: *This again.*

subject: Interrogation of the Air Temple Cultist
fact: The interrogation began with Zephyr’s aggressive posturing, failed to yield trust, and succeeded only after Calmer’s intervention. The prisoner’s cooperation was conditional on freedom, and his information proved accurate and actionable.
source_quote: Zephyr had tried persuasion first — I caught the flat delivery, saw it land badly. But with Calmer at his shoulder, he tried again, and the second attempt found its footing.

subject: Lockpicking of the Shackles
fact: The lockpicking of the prisoner’s shackles was performed with surgical precision, resulting in clean, immediate release. It was an act of physical mastery that signaled competence and earned implicit trust from the captives.
source_quote: The lock gave cleanly. The shackles came apart like they'd been waiting for me.

subject: message receipt
fact: The individual received a message calmly and unhurriedly, signaling deliberate control over his actions and environment.
source_quote: He let the runner see him receiving the message calmly. Unhurried.

subject: Necromantic Ghoul Deployment
fact: Corpses of Earth Temple members were raised as ghouls and deployed in the party’s own territory during the temple war, revealing an active necromantic operation with intimate knowledge of the party’s movements and identities — a direct threat to operational security.

subject: Necromantic Interference
fact: A necromancer is actively operating within the dungeon, raising recently deceased temple members — specifically Earth Temple corpses — and deploying them as looters and combatants during the ongoing war, indicating access to corpses, knowledge of temple structures, and strategic intent.
source_quote: Someone with necromantic power was working in this dungeon right now, during our carefully engineered war, with access to our people's corpses and apparent interest in deploying them.

subject: party flees
fact: The party begins dashing through the Air Temple corridor in a non-tactical retreat.
source_quote: The party began dashing. One by one, boots loud on stone, the Air Temple corridor filling with the very specific sound of adventurers not fighting a tactical retreat but simply *running*.

subject: Prisoner Liberation
fact: The liberation of the Air Temple cultist was a tactical decision that secured critical intelligence on the Deep Temple’s hidden passage; it was not an act of mercy but a transaction of power.

subject: prisoner release sequence
fact: The first prisoner is freed before the other four remain chained.
source_quote: The chains hit the stone floor. That was when the others found their voices. Four still chained.

subject: Sequoia kills last ghoul
fact: Sequoia puts an arrow in the back of the last ghoul before it escapes the corridor.
source_quote: Sequoia put an arrow in the back of the last one before it made it out the corridor.

subject: Sequoia kills second bugbear
fact: Sequoia delivers a finishing blow on the second bugbear with satisfying weight.
source_quote: Sequoia's finishing blow on the second had a certain satisfying weight to it.

subject: Sequoia's trap fails
fact: Sequoia’s trap mechanism fails early, and the ghouls keep coming.
source_quote: the mechanism failed at the worst possible moment — the kind of failure that makes you want to reconsider your life choices. The spring went early, the delay was nothing, and the ghouls kept coming.

subject: Summoning by Hartsch
fact: Hartsch summoned the party for an urgent war council, indicating that the Obsidian Edge is consolidating control over the aftermath of the temple collapse and preparing for its next phase.

subject: summoning sequence
fact: Hartsch summons the Obsidian Edge for a war council immediately after the prisoner's information is obtained.
source_quote: Hartsch wanted them. Hartsch wanted his Obsidian Edge assembled, upstairs, immediately. War council. The summons had the texture of *now*.

subject: Temple War Initiation
fact: The Obsidian Edge deliberately ignited war between the four temples, creating chaos to mask their own infiltration and resource acquisition; the event was not a collapse but a calculated strategy.

subject: the goblins and ghouls moving through the hidden door

subject: wraith
fact: A wraith is present in the Air Temple passage and resists two attempts of divine light from Calmer.
source_quote: The wraith looked at it. And did not flinch. ... The wraith held against it again.

subject: Wraith
fact: A wraith that resisted two full divine interventions from Calmer, remained untouched by holy light, and then announced its intent to kill one of the party — later laughing hysterically as it pursued and wounded Calmer, demonstrating supernatural resilience and psychological malice beyond typical undead.

subject: wraith
fact: A wraith was present in the Air Temple corridor and did not move as the party passed.
source_quote: When we moved back through the Air Temple, the wraith was where we'd left it. Same corridor. Same cold. Same hollow patience.

subject: Wraith
fact: The wraith is a stationary, patient undead entity that occupies a corridor with hollow patience, neither attacking nor retreating as parties pass — its inaction is more unnerving than aggression, suggesting it waits for something specific to trigger its movement.
source_quote: The wraith was where we'd left it. Same corridor. Same cold. Same hollow patience. The wraith didn't move as we cleared its territory. That was worse.

subject: Wraith
fact: The wraith is an undead abomination that resisted two divine attacks, endured a pistol shot, and laughed hysterically after striking the cleric from behind, demonstrating immunity to conventional force and supernatural power.
source_quote: The wraith remained exactly as present... dispersed twice into the air... stood untouched and completely unbothered... the wraith laughed at me. *Hysterically.*

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believes St. Cuthbert does not permit elsewhere as a destination when undead are in the corridor.
source_quote: St. Cuthbert does not permit elsewhere as a destination when undead are in the corridor.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believes he is harder to hit than most due to his plate mail.
source_quote: I have good reason to believe I am harder to hit than most.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believes his divine power should have worked on the wraith by theological logic.
source_quote: the divine power of St. Cuthbert... that should by every measure of theological logic have worked today

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believes the wraith's indifference is contemptuous.
source_quote: the cold contempt of its existence

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer channels divine light from St. Cuthbert, Cudgel of Ortho, the Arbiter Eternal, twice against the wraith.
source_quote: I gathered the light. I thrust it outward — the real thing, the genuine article, the power that has cracked ghoul skulls and sent lesser dead screaming into whatever passes for oblivion on the other side. ... I tried again.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer felt an animal want-to-be-elsewhere when confronting the wraith.
source_quote: Pure, animal want-to-be-elsewhere.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer hates the wraith for what it is and what it represents.
source_quote: I hate this thing. I hate what it is, what it represents

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer intends not to be the one who dies today.
source_quote: But not me, I explained, to no one in particular, or possibly to St. Cuthbert directly, and I dashed.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a cleric of St. Cuthbert who has suffered two catastrophic failures against a wraith, endured physical and spiritual trauma, and then unleashed a violent, uncontrolled surge of divine power against ghouls — an outburst so extreme it has raised suspicions among allies that his faith may be compromised or overtaken by something darker.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a priest who has survived being killed once, and his presence alters the emotional dynamic of interactions, inducing caution or submission in others.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a priest who has survived death once, and carries an aura that shifts the atmosphere of a room when he steps forward. His presence lends gravity and credibility to persuasion, making previously ineffective approaches succeed.
source_quote: There's something about a priest who's survived being killed once that reads differently than before. The prisoner felt it.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a war cleric of St. Cuthbert who hates undead with theological certainty, but recently exhibited unnerving, escalating fervor during combat — including a vocal, repetitive 'yes yes yes' eruption, divine power release, and loss of self-control — raising questions about whether his actions stem from him or something wearing his voice.
source_quote: Calmer was going "yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!" The cursing started. *This is how the power of—* and then more cursing. The sentence never finished. He didn't need it to.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is haunted by the wraith laughing at him hysterically after his failed attempts.
source_quote: came the sound of the wraith laughing at me. *Hysterically.* It laughed at me *hysterically*.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer refuses to believe he survived being killed and revived just to be mocked by an undead abomination.
source_quote: I did not survive all of that to be mocked by something that doesn't even have the decency to be alive when it defies me.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer says 'yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!' as he channels divine power against the ghouls.
source_quote: Calmer was going "yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!"

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer unleashed a single pulse of guiding radiance that dissolved the double doors of the barricade, triggering the collapse of the enemy line and fulfilling the tactical objective.
source_quote: A single pulse of guiding radiance, the kind of divine light that doesn't ask permission, and the double doors at the barricade simply *stopped existing as an obstacle*.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer's breathing slowly returned to something resembling normal.
source_quote: The sounds of Calmer's breathing slowly returned to something resembling normal.

subject: Calmer's resurrection count
fact: Calmer has been killed once and revived in the temple.
source_quote: I have been killed once already in this gods-forsaken temple, revived at considerable cost

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch is currently demanding the assembled Obsidian Edge be brought upstairs immediately, as per the urgent summons from the war council, and is regarded as useful enough to require maintenance.
source_quote: Hartsch wanted his Obsidian Edge assembled, upstairs, immediately. War council. The summons had the texture of *now*.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch is referenced in Zephyr's thoughts as part of the operation's context.
source_quote: thinking about Romag and Hartsch and the seventeen ways this whole operation could collapse before morning.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch is the leader of the Obsidian Edge, who summoned Zephyr and the party for an urgent war council, indicating centralized control over the faction’s strategic response to the temple collapse.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch is useful and requires maintenance, and he whistles to summon the Obsidian Edge as part of a confirmed arrangement.
source_quote: Hartsch whistled and the Obsidian Edge came running, because that was the arrangement they had made

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch summoned the Obsidian Edge for a war council immediately.
source_quote: Hartsch wanted them. Hartsch wanted his Obsidian Edge assembled, upstairs, immediately. War council. The summons had the texture of now.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch was useful and useful things required maintenance.
source_quote: Hartsch was useful and useful things required maintenance

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch whistled and the Obsidian Edge came running.
source_quote: Hartsch whistled and the Obsidian Edge came running

subject: he
fact: He felt the particular indignity of being someone else's asset while trying to build his own balance sheet.
source_quote: The particular indignity of being someone else's asset while you were trying to build your own balance sheet.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is an Air Temple cleric who appeared as background noise during prior interactions, but has now revealed himself as a covert operator exploiting the temple war — using the chaos to send his agents through hidden passages to loot corpses, weapons, and coin while others fight and die.
source_quote: Kelno's people. The Air Temple cleric who had sat across from Romag's table like furniture, quiet enough that I'd filed him under *background noise* and moved on. That was a mistake.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is the Air Temple cleric who quietly orchestrated his faction's infiltration of the collapsing temple war; he let other factions destroy each other while his agents looted and secured resources, positioning himself as the ultimate beneficiary.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is the Air Temple cleric who sat across from Romag's table like furniture.
source_quote: Kelno's people. The Air Temple cleric who had sat across from Romag's table like furniture, quiet enough that I'd filed him under background noise and moved on.

subject: prisoner count
fact: Five prisoners are chained in the chamber, one of whom is freed.
source_quote: They were huddled against the far wall, chained at the wrist... Four still chained.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag is referenced in Zephyr's thoughts as part of the operation's context.
source_quote: thinking about Romag and Hartsch and the seventeen ways this whole operation could collapse before morning.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag's anger is one of the loud players in the faction politics of the temples.
source_quote: Romag's anger. The Fire Temple's fire. The Water Temple's ambition.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia delivered a finishing blow on the second bugbear with a satisfying weight, contributing decisively to the collapse of the barricade.
source_quote: Sequoia's finishing blow on the second had a certain satisfying weight to it.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is a party member who attempted to set a trap at the corridor door during the ghoul ambush, but the mechanism failed prematurely.
source_quote: Sequoia moved fast — bless him — already working to set something at the door. But the ghouls rolled forward like they had somewhere to be, and whatever trap he was laying, they hit it before it was ready.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is a reliable and decisive ally who executes finishing blows with surgical precision, sets traps under pressure, and remains grounded amid chaos, but is increasingly aware of the unsettling transformation in Calmer’s behavior and the broader necromantic threat within the temple.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is an assassin and scout who reads environmental traces with precision — foot traffic, bloodstain direction, armor placement — and acted decisively to end the final ghoul with a clean arrow shot through the back before it could escape the corridor.
source_quote: Sequoia put an arrow in the back of the last one before it made it out the corridor. Clean finish. That's Sequoia.

subject: St. Cuthbert
fact: St. Cuthbert is referenced as the deity whose training guides Calmer’s response to undead.
source_quote: I knew before I turned the corner. Not by sight or sound — by the particular wrongness that St. Cuthbert's training leaves in a cleric who has seen enough of what shouldn't exist.

subject: St. Cuthbert
fact: St. Cuthbert is referred to as the Cudgel of Ortho and the Arbiter Eternal.
source_quote: The divine light of St. Cuthbert, Cudgel of Ortho, the Arbiter Eternal, dispersed twice into the air of a dank dungeon corridor

subject: St. Cuthbert
fact: St. Cuthbert is the divine patron of orthodoxy and justice, invoked by the cleric in two failed attempts to banish the wraith, whose power is expected to work but did not.
source_quote: The divine light of St. Cuthbert, Cudgel of Ortho, the Arbiter Eternal, dispersed twice into the air of a dank dungeon corridor.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor is referenced as having drowned Calmer with magic.
source_quote: He has been burned by fire priests and drowned by Thalsor's magic

subject: The Freed Prisoner
fact: The freed prisoner is a former Air Temple cultist, imprisoned for factional reasons; he is intelligent, pragmatic, and skilled at reading power dynamics — he traded knowledge of the Deep Temple’s hidden passage for his freedom.

subject: The Freed Prisoner
fact: The freed prisoner is an Air Temple cultist, captured for faction politics. He is intelligent, observant, and strategically self-preserving. He traded information only after securing his freedom, and revealed a hidden passage to the Deep Temple sourced directly from Kelno — indicating insider knowledge.
source_quote: He pointed it out on our map. Precise. A hidden passage inside the Air Temple itself, knowledge he'd gotten directly from Kelno — which meant it was the kind of information that doesn't circulate widely.

subject: the freed prisoner
fact: The freed prisoner knew about the Deep Temple and revealed a hidden passage inside the Air Temple.
source_quote: I guess I would be pushing my luck if I insisted for more help, wouldn't I? My mother never raised — didn't raise me to be a fool. Alright. So here's the secret door to the Greater Temple.

subject: the freed prisoner
fact: The freed prisoner received his information about the Deep Temple directly from Kelno.
source_quote: knowledge he'd gotten directly from Kelno — which meant it was the kind of information that doesn't circulate widely, the kind you only know if you were close enough to matter or close enough to overhear.

subject: the freed prisoner
fact: The freed prisoner's mother raised him not to be a fool.
source_quote: My mother never raised — didn't raise me to be a fool.

subject: the runner
fact: An Earth Temple runner arrived with a summons from Hartsch for the Obsidian Edge.
source_quote: An Earth Temple runner, collar damp with effort, mouth already open before he'd finished stopping. Hartsch wanted them. Hartsch wanted his Obsidian Edge assembled, upstairs, immediately. War council. The summons had the texture of now.

subject: The Wraith
fact: The Wraith resisted Calmer's holy light, which dissolved into the cold air without effect, demonstrating unnatural resilience to divine power.
source_quote: The wraith looked at it. And did not flinch. The holy light dissolved into the cold air like breath in winter, leaving exactly nothing behind.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr attempted to use Goblin as a diplomatic language to communicate with elemental entities, but recognized the futility of the attempt and abandoned the plan.
source_quote: Speak goblin," Zephyr offered anyway. ... "Alright," Zephyr said. "This plan is done.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr believes the ghouls appearing in their territory was not part of the plan.
source_quote: Ghouls lurching into our territory... was not in the plan.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr feels deeply unpleasant about ghouls being former Earth Temple members he knew.
source_quote: That was the worst part. Not strangers... People we'd seen in corridors, nodded to... Now raised...

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr fired a precise arrow into the mist from the edge of the corridor, efficiently targeting the enemy and demonstrating rare tactical discipline.
source_quote: Zephyr put an arrow into the mist from the edge of the corridor — precise, efficient, for once doing the sensible thing from distance.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr has been paralyzed by ghouls before and has a personal interest in killing them first.
source_quote: I've been paralyzed by ghouls before (we all have, at this point)... so I have a very personal and practical interest in killing them first.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr has filed away Zinnia's concern that Calmer is going native.
source_quote: the concern Zinnia had put into words once, something about Calmer going native, which I am choosing not to look at directly.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is a horned interrogator who extracts information through intimidation and bravado, later refining his approach with Calmer’s presence. He has a sharp memory for spatial details and turns verbal directions into mental keys. He is driven by results, not elegance.
source_quote: Zephyr leaned on the man harder than necessary, all bravado and borrowed threat, standing at the full height the horns gave him and hoping the prisoner would fill in the rest.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is a member of the party who fired a pistol at the wraith, landing the only wound it sustained before fleeing into a secret passage.
source_quote: Zephyr raised his pistol. The shot caught the wraith across what might generously be called its torso — a wound that barely registered on something like this — the only wound anyone managed to land on the thing before he broke for the secret passage.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is a precise and efficient combatant who consistently acts with tactical clarity — landing arrows, pistol shots, and dagger strikes with lethal accuracy — and is now questioning the nature of Calmer’s recent outbursts of divine power and their possible connection to deeper corruption or possession.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is an information-driven operative with a blunt, confrontational style; he extracts knowledge through pressure and is unbothered by moral ambiguity, but his methods often lack finesse.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is calmly receiving the runner’s directions, filing them away with other planned obligations, and is choosing to act unhurriedly as a man who goes where he chooses, despite being entangled in obligations tied to Hartsch.
source_quote: Zephyr looked at the runner, then at the corridor beyond him, then at nothing in particular. He filed the directions away... He let the runner see him receiving the message calmly. Unhurried.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr puts an arrow into the mist from the edge of the corridor.
source_quote: Zephyr put an arrow into the mist from the edge of the corridor

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr was still moving like something inside him wasn't quite right.
source_quote: Zephyr was still moving like something inside him wasn't quite right.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr wonders if Calmer's outburst is him or something else wearing his voice.
source_quote: is that him, or is that something else wearing his voice?

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia believes it is operational hygiene to exit the kill zone she created before it becomes indiscriminate.
source_quote: That's just operational hygiene.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia believes the geometry of taking the hinge of the barricade was not impatience but strategy.
source_quote: That's not impatience. That's geometry.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia expressed concern that Calmer was going native.
source_quote: the concern Zinnia had put into words once, something about Calmer going native

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia feels her ribs have opinions about how quickly they should move.
source_quote: My ribs had opinions about how quickly we should move.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia has observed Calmer’s behavioral shifts with quiet concern, noting his unnatural intensity and possible loss of self — particularly his tendency to 'go native' under pressure — and has filed these observations without voicing them aloud, treating them as operational anomalies rather than personal crises.
source_quote: The concern Zinnia had put into words once, something about Calmer going native, which I am choosing not to look at directly.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a battle-hardened operative who assessed and exploited a choke point during the temple conflict, taking a critical hit that reoriented their perception of the fight, and is now prioritizing disengagement due to escalating environmental hazards and personal injury.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a hyper-observant professional who reads environments and people with clinical precision; she notices subtle cues — door movements, body language, environmental grammar — and files them without immediate judgment.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a party member who fled down the corridor during the wraith’s threat, joining the group’s panicked retreat.
source_quote: The party began dashing. One by one, boots loud on stone, the Air Temple corridor filling with the very specific sound of adventurers not fighting a tactical retreat but simply *running*. Sequoia. Zinnia. Zephyr already gone.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a perceptive observer skilled at reading micro-expressions and emotional truth. He noticed the freed prisoner’s sincerity before any words were spoken and confirmed the man was telling the truth — a judgment that influenced the group’s trust.
source_quote: I saw him do that thing: the small stillness, the focused attention. He's good at reading people. Better than he lets on, and he already lets on plenty.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a professional observer who catalogs everything without sentiment, noting patterns in ruins, objects, and behavior with clinical precision.
source_quote: I catalogued them the way I catalogue everything, automatically, without sentiment.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia knows she rushed in.
source_quote: I know. I know I rushed in.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia watched the prisoner the whole time and gave a look that meant 'this one's telling the truth.'
source_quote: Zinnia had been watching the man the whole time. I saw him do that thing: the small stillness, the focused attention. He's good at reading people. Better than he lets on, and he already lets on plenty. Whatever he saw, it settled something, because he gave me the look that means: this one's telling the truth.

subject: bags
fact: Goblins hauled bags that clinked with the unmistakable weight of coin.
source_quote: hauling bags that clinked with the unmistakable weight of coin.

subject: Bags of Coin
fact: The bags of coin are looted wealth carried by Kelno’s goblins; each bag weighs approximately sixty pounds and represents the tangible spoils of the temple war, now in the hands of a silent victor.

subject: bag weight
fact: Each bag carried by the goblins weighs approximately sixty pounds.
source_quote: one bag, maybe sixty pounds of someone else's gold

subject: Barricade (pews and rubble)
fact: The barricade, constructed from pews and rubble, served as a choke point that held the advance until it was destroyed by divine intervention.
source_quote: Bugbears behind an improvised barricade of pews and rubble...

subject: black stone steps
fact: The broad steps of dull black stone descend from the north wall into shadow, serving as a physical pathway toward deeper, unknown regions of the ruin.
source_quote: Broad steps of dull black stone descended from the north wall into shadow.

subject: Blessed Plate Mail
fact: Calmer’s blessed plate mail, the finest protection available to a cleric of his station, was pierced by the wraith’s touch and then compounded by a stray fire bolt — proving even superior magical armor cannot guarantee survival against supernatural malice.

subject: Captain Tolub's ship schedule
fact: Captain Tolub's ship schedule is a tracked logistical detail that Zephyr maintains in his mental ledger of obligations and future actions.
source_quote: He filed the directions away in the same place he kept everything he planned to collect later: the Rhennee debt, Captain Tolub's ship schedule, the exact weight of every favor he was owed.

subject: Dagger
fact: Zephyr carries a dagger, drawn in anticipation of ghoul attack, as part of his prepared response to paralysis-inducing undead.
source_quote: The dagger was already in my hand.

subject: Dropped Ghoul
fact: The dropped ghoul — killed by Sequoia’s arrow before it could act — is a physical artifact of necromantic interference, bearing the insignia of the Earth Temple and demonstrating the precision of its reanimation and deployment.
