fact: Two cultists wielded blades of conjured force that hovered in the air, ready to strike — but were neutralized before they could activate.
source_quote: blades of conjured force already hanging in the air, hovering, ready for trouble.

subject: cult fanatics
fact: Two cult fanatics with blades of conjured force are present behind the west door of the Water Temple.
source_quote: They were cult fanatics, and not entirely stupid: blades of conjured force already hanging in the air, hovering, ready for trouble.

subject: Falrinth count
fact: Falrinth is a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own.
source_quote: Falrinth, a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own.

subject: gnoll
fact: A gnoll was charred and its smell had been hanging in the corridors all morning.
source_quote: Somewhere south of us the smell of charred gnoll had been hanging in the corridors all morning

subject: hill giant
fact: A hill giant is present in the lower chamber where Barkinar meets the intruders.
source_quote: The room at the bottom was built to remove the question of whether we could fight our way out. A hill giant. Ogres at the walls.

subject: Hill Giant
fact: A hill giant stood as a silent enforcer in Barkinar’s chamber, part of a lethal deterrent designed to prevent escape and ensure compliance during the summons.

subject: hill giant count
fact: A hill giant was stationed in Barkinar's chamber as a deterrent to rebellion.
source_quote: A hill giant.

subject: Kelno’s Goblins
fact: Kelno’s goblins are his primary enforcers and scouts, part of his bribery and surveillance network. They are now being offered to the player group as part of the partnership — their loyalty shifting from Kelno to the group as the new power.
source_quote: His goblins, mine. His informants, mine. The throne, mine.

subject: ogre count
fact: Ogres were stationed at the walls of Barkinar's chamber as enforcers.
source_quote: Ogres at the walls.

subject: ogres
fact: Ogres stand at the walls of the lower chamber where Barkinar meets the intruders.
source_quote: The room at the bottom was built to remove the question of whether we could fight our way out. A hill giant. Ogres at the walls.

subject: Ogres
fact: Ogres were stationed along the walls of Barkinar’s chamber, forming a physical barrier and psychological intimidation tactic to reinforce the Greater Temple’s dominance and the party’s helplessness.

subject: Senshock count
fact: Senshock, the Lord Wizard of the Greater Temple, is ambitious, paranoid, and useful.
source_quote: Senshock — our Lord Wizard — has opinions about new arrivals. He is ambitious and paranoid. He is also useful.

subject: Serpentine Idol
fact: The idol in the alcove is a horrid knot of fish, eels, and octopi sculpted into one mass, taller than a man, draped in seaweed. It is not mere art — it is the temple’s god, and it is aware.
source_quote: An idol of serpentine stone: a writhing knot of fish and eels and octopi sculpted into one horrid mass... with a seaweed drapery hung across the wall behind.

subject: The Assassins
fact: Assassins hired to kill Hartsch were instructed to avoid the player group, indicating the group has become a recognized, untouchable force even among enemies. Their presence confirms the scale of the power struggle and the group’s unintended status as a wildcard.
source_quote: Even the man trying to murder our puppet had given orders to leave us breathing.

subject: The Wraith
fact: The wraith was a spectral entity that resisted divine power, laughing at Calmer’s holy radiance until it was destroyed; its defeat cost Calmer dearly and marked the beginning of his physical and spiritual decline.
source_quote: Twice the holy radiance had hit the wraith and simply ceased — the way divine light ceases when it finds nothing that recognizes it.

subject: wraith
fact: Calmer killed a wraith twice with holy radiance before finally destroying it on the third attempt.
source_quote: Twice it had laughed at the holy power I called down in His name. Twice the holy radiance had hit the wraith and simply ceased — ... and twice I had felt the outrage of it — ... I had called the light one final time and it had answered. The chamber went white. The wraith came apart.

subject: Wraith
fact: The wraith was a spectral entity of divine corruption that resisted holy power until Calmer's repeated invocation of radiance shattered it; it laughed at divine authority and was the first major supernatural threat overcome in the temple.

subject: Alrrem
fact: Alrrem is already on his pyre when Dren reports to Sequoia.
source_quote: Alrrem's on his pyre," he went on.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar brings Calmer with him, half-carried, when meeting the intruders in the lower chamber.
source_quote: Barkinar brought Calmer with him, half-carried, assuming — as everyone assumed — that the cleric was the chief of us.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar considers Senshock ambitious and paranoid but useful.
source_quote: Senshock — our Lord Wizard — has opinions about new arrivals. He is ambitious and paranoid. He is also useful.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar is the enforcer of the Greater Temple who has observed the party’s actions from hidden passages for two weeks, knows more than he reveals, and has eliminated four named threats with precision. He demands organizational order in the Upper Temple within a week and holds leverage over the party through their assumed hierarchy and hidden knowledge.
source_quote: Romag. Hartsch. Alrrem. Belsornig... four problems gone by sundown. You will forgive me if I'm impressed.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar is the leader of the Greater Temple who summons the intruders after they take the Water Temple.
source_quote: One of them announced, gruff and flat, that Barkinar wished to speak to the new rulers of the Upper Temple.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar lists Romag, Hartsch, Alrrem, and Belsornig as problems eliminated by the intruders.
source_quote: "Romag. Hartsch. Alrrem. Belsornig," Barkinar said. "Problems I had on a list yesterday morning, and four problems gone by sundown."

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar refers to Calmer as a 'puppet master' when speaking from the stairs.
source_quote: "That was efficient. Come down, bring your puppet master if he is alive. We should talk."

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar smiles at Kelno when he sees him held captive in the lower chamber.
source_quote: Beside me they set Kelno, and Barkinar looked at him and smiled.

subject: Barkinar
fact: Barkinar, representative of the Greater Temple, summoned the party after the fall of the Upper Temple, revealing he had observed their entire campaign from hidden vantage points and now demands they organize the conquered temple under his authority within a week.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is identified by the cultists as the Prophet of Water and the target of the intruders.
source_quote: News for the big boss. News for Belsornig.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is reading a scroll when the intruders enter the chamber.
source_quote: He never turned... He'd been reading a scroll.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is targeted by an assassination plot and is pulling his treasury out via the south route.
source_quote: Belsornig — *by the cannon of the crushing wave*, the man liked the name — the assassination plot against Hartsch... ... Belsornig pulling his treasury out the south route.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is the Prophet of Water, preoccupied with a scroll when infiltrators breached his temple, and was killed without ever fully registering the threat.
source_quote: Belsornig, Prophet of Water, was preoccupied... He swayed. One more hit and there'd be nothing left to question.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig, Prophet of Water, was preoccupied with a scroll when the party infiltrated his sanctum; he was killed swiftly by Zephyr using Kelno’s Dagger of Venom, unaware of the breach until it was too late.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig, the Prophet of Water, is killed by Zephyr using the Dagger of Venom.
source_quote: I crossed the last step, found the soft place under the ribs, and drove Kelno's gift home. The Prophet of Water folded onto his own wet floor.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer believes he is the boss and should lead, but is being carried away from the fight.
source_quote: I am the boss. Yes, I am. And the boss does not run from evil. But they carried me anyway...

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a cleric who cannot utter his god's name in the temple, resulting in his prayers manifesting as complaints and despair; he was severely injured after slaying a wraith with divine radiance and is now being carried away from the battlefield by Dren's mercenaries, deemed too vulnerable to continue fighting.
source_quote: I am the boss. Yes, I am. And the boss does not run from evil. But they carried me anyway...

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is a figure of safety — possibly a prisoner, ally, or asset — who remains upstairs, unharmed. His presence suggests the group has secured key personnel, and his safety is a sign of their growing control over the environment.
source_quote: Calmer was upstairs. Safe. Or as safe as anything in here.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is believed by the Greater Temple to be the cleric and chief of the intruders, though he is injured.
source_quote: The cleric is in charge, of course." and "He's hurt. He will be fine.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is carried up the stairs by Dren's mercenaries after being severely injured in the fight against the wraith.
source_quote: The man was being carried. Hands had me. Many hands, rough hands, the wrong hands — Dren's people, hauling me up off the marble by the arms and the plate, my heels dragging across the brown stone with its black veins, my mace knocking against someone's shin.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is described as a cleric who cannot say his god's name in the temple, causing his prayers to come out as complaints.
source_quote: Calmer wasn't a worrier. He just couldn't say his own god's name in here, so it came out sideways, as complaint.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is placed upstairs under the care of Dren's mercenaries to prevent him from re-entering the fight.
source_quote: Deeply injured, parked with Dren's mercenaries somewhere behind a curtain so he wouldn't get himself killed reaching for a god he can't name in here.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is the boss, severely injured and being carried away from the battlefield by Dren's mercenaries, convinced he is being protected but is in fact being removed from the fight; he believes he is losing his relevance and is haunted by a cold presence in his chest that whispers doubt and detachment.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is the cleric who has been mistakenly perceived by the Greater Temple and its agents as the leader of the party, though he is injured and not in command. His perceived authority is a deliberate misreading exploited by the party as leverage.
source_quote: The cleric is in charge, of course.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is the injured cleric who cannot speak his god’s name in this place — it comes out as complaint. He is helpless, unable to run, and the only man in the temple whose vulnerability is tied to sacred silence.
source_quote: He just couldn't say his own god's name in here, so it came out sideways, as complaint.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer, the cleric, was presumed by Barkinar and the bugbears to be the leader of the party; Zephyr lied that he was injured but would recover, allowing the group to maintain the illusion of his authority while concealing their true command structure.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren carries Calmer up two flights of brown marble stairs after the battle with the wraith.
source_quote: Dren had carried him up two flights of brown marble and the thanks he wanted was to be heard out about it.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is a mercenary captain who remains loyal to Zephyr and his team despite the treacherous environment; he carries out orders without question and is entrusted with guarding Calmer, the only person in the temple whose loyalty cannot be bought.
source_quote: You didn't put me in charge of mercenaries, because I tell you what to do.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is a subordinate who has already completed the task the group requested — descending the corridor while they ascended, proving he understands their timing and authority. He views Kelno as a nuisance, reinforcing the group’s rising dominance.
source_quote: Oh my god," he said, "that guy whines a lot." A pause. "He won't shut up.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is instructed to stay behind with Calmer and guard him with his mercenaries.
source_quote: "Take your mercenaries and stay back," Zephyr landed on, finally.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is the leader of the mercenaries hired to protect Calmer; his people are tasked with keeping Calmer alive but are unaware that their actions are effectively sidelining the true leader of the mission.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is the only loyal man in the temple — he follows only us, refuses mercenary deals, and acts on truth rather than coin. He is not a mercenary in the room’s sense; he is the blade that points our direction and means it.
source_quote: He didn't take orders, except from us, and that was the whole point of him.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is the only mercenary who consistently follows Calmer and Zephyr’s orders without betrayal.
source_quote: He wouldn't. I didn't know why. Maybe it was the negotiation. Maybe he just liked having someone tell him the truth about what he was for. Either way he was the only blade in this entire stone box that pointed our direction and meant it.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren reports that Belsornig's people are at the captain's door and that Alrrem is on his pyre.
source_quote: "The captain, the captain? March is finished." Dren said it fast, the way men say things they ran to deliver. "Belsornig's people are at his door. He's screaming for you." ... "Alrrem's on his pyre," he went on.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren says 'okay, boss' before the infiltration of the Water Temple begins.
source_quote: Dren said "okay, boss," and that was the last easy thing.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren states that he was not put in charge of mercenaries and that he only follows orders.
source_quote: "You didn't put me in charge of mercenaries, because I tell you what to do." He shrugged, a soldier's shrug. "You tell me."

subject: Falrinth
fact: Falrinth is a rogue wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons unknown; Barkinar mentioned him as a potential future contact, hinting at deeper fractures within the temple hierarchy.

subject: Falrinth
fact: Falrinth is a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own.
source_quote: A second name, set down lighter, for later: Falrinth, a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own.

subject: Falrinth
fact: Falrinth is a wizard in hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own. Barkinar mentions him as a potential future point of discussion, suggesting he is a wildcard with undisclosed significance to the temple’s internal politics.
source_quote: We could talk about Falrinth later.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch is assassinated by agents who reached his antechamber an hour prior to the meeting with Kelno.
source_quote: Assassins had reached Hartsch's antechamber an hour ago. By tonight our puppet would be meat.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno admits his guards are the worst in the dungeon and that he could easily be killed.
source_quote: I could kill him — worst guards in the dungeon, he admitted it himself — and then walk into the deep temple blind...

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno gave Zephyr the Dagger of Venom and requested he use it to kill Belsornig.
source_quote: "I've been saving this to kill Belsornig for some time. If you wouldn't mind doing me the honors?"... I'd taken his deal... "Well, I'll give it to you. Take it," I'd said

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is a cunning, aged operative who has survived by aligning with shifting power structures. He acknowledges chaos and appetite over loyalty, and has been waiting two weeks for the player group to become the fourth temple — positioning himself as a viable partner. He controls informants, goblins, and a network of bribery, and has secretly set out a second chair in anticipation of their arrival.
source_quote: He smiled and gave me nothing. Loyalty to the power of air, he said, the way a man swears loyalty to weather.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is a mysterious figure who gifted the Dagger of Venom to the infiltrator, requesting it be used to kill Belsornig, and is aligned with chaos but also with the value of living.
source_quote: The Dagger of Venom. Kelno's gift... I'd taken his deal in seconds because his answer had been honest — for chaos, but also for living.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is a prisoner held by the Greater Temple, placed beside the party during their meeting with Barkinar. His presence and Barkinar’s smile at him indicate Kelno has been under observation and possibly complicit or compromised, making him a key to hidden loyalties.
source_quote: Barkinar looked at him and smiled. I filed that. A man who smiles at the prisoner he has been watching from hidden passages for two weeks is a man who already knows more than he is saying.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is an elderly, cunning prophet of air who has survived multiple temple wars by aligning with the strongest faction; he offers Zephyr control of his intelligence network in exchange for partnership, revealing he anticipated the war and prepared the second chair for Zephyr weeks in advance.
source_quote: I've noted for a week... You are going to be the one.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is an old cultist who offers Zephyr a deal to become his number two and take control of his goblins and informants.
source_quote: Or I could walk out with him as my number two. His goblins, mine. His informants, mine. The throne, mine. His little office, his.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is held captive in the lower chamber beneath the Water Temple and is set beside Zinnia by Barkinar's orders.
source_quote: Beside me they set Kelno, and Barkinar looked at him and smiled.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno keeps a ledger detailing payments to a dozen names and a note saying "set out the second chair," placed two weeks prior.
source_quote: A ledger. Payments out to a dozen names. And a little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno values survival over loyalty and seeks to remain alive by aligning with the strongest faction.
source_quote: Yes, I am for chaos, but I'm also for living.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno, a prisoner of the Greater Temple, was brought before Barkinar; he had previously given Zephyr the Dagger of Venom to kill Belsornig, indicating a personal grudge and alignment with chaos — a bond Zephyr respected.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag was killed at his own table by the group's prior actions.
source_quote: We took bribes from the Fire Temple, sold a chimera, knifed Romag at his own table, and pointed three armies at each other until they marched.

subject: Senshock
fact: Senshock is the Lord Wizard of the Greater Temple — ambitious, paranoid, and useful. Barkinar advises the party to be civil to him and let him underestimate them, indicating he is a dangerous but manipulable variable in the temple’s power structure.
source_quote: Senshock — our Lord Wizard — has opinions about new arrivals. He is ambitious and paranoid. He is also useful. Be civil, and let him underestimate you.

subject: Senshock
fact: Senshock is the Lord Wizard of the Greater Temple, described as ambitious and paranoid but useful.
source_quote: Senshock — our Lord Wizard — has opinions about new arrivals. He is ambitious and paranoid. He is also useful.

subject: Senshock
fact: Senshock, the Lord Wizard of the Greater Temple, is described by Barkinar as ambitious, paranoid, and useful — a dangerous figure the party must appease by letting him underestimate them.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia declares that the group are the victors after realizing they have manipulated the temple war.
source_quote: "We are the victors," Sequoia said.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is a blunt, observant member of Zephyr’s inner circle who voices the group’s cynical realism; he recognizes the power dynamics of the temple war and affirms their position as the inevitable victors through calculated inaction and exploitation.
source_quote: We are the victors.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is a silent, efficient operative aligned with Zephyr, moving with him and Zinnia into the Air Temple; she represents the disciplined force that executes the mission while Calmer is incapacitated and removed.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is the de facto leader of the player group, known for terse communication and strategic patience. He recognizes the group’s unclaimed dominance after the deaths of Hartsch and Romag, and has accepted Kelno’s partnership — not out of trust, but because it serves their expanding operation. He is the one who initiates the deal and frames their rise as inevitable victory.
source_quote: We are the victors," Sequoia said. And he was right, and that was the thing I'd been circling without letting myself touch.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia is the silent observer who confirms decisions with minimal words. His 'Yep' ends debate. He is not a strategist — he is the anchor of consensus.
source_quote: Sequoia agreed in a word — 'Yep' — and that settled it.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia provided quick-witted cover during the infiltration, offering the lie 'Housekeeping!' when the door was breached, and later participated in the takedown of Belsornig’s guards, then killed the final cultist after Zephyr’s strike.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia responds to Kelno's offer by saying, "We sit there silently and menacingly," and is acknowledged for the menace.
source_quote: "Yeah," Sequoia said. "We sit there silently and menacingly." He appreciated the menace.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia responds to Zinnia's door failure with the word "Yep" to agree not to take treasure.
source_quote: Sequoia agreed in a word — "Yep" — and that settled it.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia shouts "Housekeeping!" as a bluff when the cultists behind the door question the intruders.
source_quote: Sequoia, without missing a beat: "Housekeeping!"

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia supported Zinnia's failed breach, offered a clumsy cover story ('Housekeeping!'), and later killed the second cultist after Zinnia struck the first blow.
source_quote: Sequoia, without missing a beat: 'Housekeeping!'... Sequoia opened him up. Sequoia stepped over the body and ended the rest of it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr asks Kelno if he is for or against 'the pimple,' referring to the current power structure.
source_quote: "Kelno," I said. "So — are you for or against? The pimple." My mouth tripped over the word and I let it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr claims to be a messenger for Kelno when the cultists behind the door demand identification.
source_quote: I tried Kelno — "We are messengers for Kelno"

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr claims to be bearing news for Belsornig to deceive the cultists behind the door.
source_quote: News for the big boss. News for Belsornig.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr fumbles the suggestion to leave Dren with Kelno, then corrects himself upon remembering Calmer is upstairs.
source_quote: You could stay here with — what's his name. Kelno." Then he caught himself. Calmer was upstairs. We took him up. "Oh. Shit."

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is a pragmatic, ruthless leader who manipulates factions into civil war to seize control of the Greater Temple; he brokers a deal with Kelno, accepts his intelligence network and goblins, and strategically removes Calmer from combat to preserve his own operational autonomy.
source_quote: We are the victors... This is starting to be a very lucrative operation.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is an assassin who believes surprise is a sentence already finished before the target knows it started, and who chose the west door for its fewer rooms and lower risk of detection.
source_quote: Zephyr wanted the west — fewer rooms to cross, less chance of stumbling into something.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is an assassin who shifted tactics from forced entry to deception, successfully bluffing the cultists into opening the west door by posing as messengers bearing news of Belsornig’s assassination, then eliminating both guards with precision.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is the de facto leader of the party, pragmatic and ruthless, who orchestrated Calmer's removal from the front lines to ensure mission continuity; he leads the group into the Air Temple with Zinnia and Sequoia, and has no qualms about letting the starving prophets turn on each other to secure dominance.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is the strategist who calculates corpse value, route efficiency, and tactical risk with grim precision. He is not a leader — he is the math behind the decision, and he knows it.
source_quote: He's better at the math when there's more than one prize in the room.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr leads the group into the Air Temple after Calmer is removed from the party.
source_quote: Calmer wasn't with us. ... I had the others. And I had the only thing in this temple that ever told me the truth: four starving prophets...

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr listens at the west door of the Water Temple before the infiltration attempt.
source_quote: Zephyr put his ear to the door first, the way you do, listening for the thing on the other side before you give it a reason to listen back.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr respects Kelno as an honest man with a poisoned knife and a grudge.
source_quote: An honest man with a poisoned knife and a grudge. I respected all three.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr says 'Let's go export' when entering the Air Temple, a phrase nobody corrects.
source_quote: "Let's go export," I said, which is not how the word goes, but nobody corrected me, and we went.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr trusts Kelno because he recognizes his honest hunger to survive, not false loyalty.
source_quote: That was the genuine article. Not loyalty — appetite, the clean honest hunger of a man who only wants to wake up tomorrow. I respect that. I trust it more than I'd ever trust a vow.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia attempted to breach the west door with force, bounced back twice, and later provided false credentials as messengers for Kelno before revealing a forged letter of assassination as proof.
source_quote: Zinnia hit the door and the door hit back... Zinnia produced the proof.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia attempts to break down the west door of the Water Temple by shoulder-ramming it twice.
source_quote: I set myself, and I hit it. It didn't give. I bounced... I set again and hit it a second time, everything I had... and it threw me again.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia believes the bronze everywhere had been untouched for a long time, or nobody dares.
source_quote: Bronze everywhere, all of it gone to verdigris, that green crust that says nobody has touched this in a long time, or nobody dares.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia expresses suspicion toward Kelno during the negotiation in the Air Temple.
source_quote: "We have to be suspicious of him," Zinnia said.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is one of Zephyr's trusted lieutenants, quiet and lethal, following him into the Air Temple with Sequoia; she is part of the core team that enters the active combat zone while Calmer is sidelined.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is perceptive and skeptical, the one who identifies the weak point in any arrangement — the place where something is already going to give. She challenges Kelno’s motives and forces the group to confront the moral ambiguity of their rise, serving as the group’s moral compass.
source_quote: She was right. She has a way of finding the part of a thing that doesn't hold — the place where it was already going to give.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is the infiltrator tasked with breaching barriers, but failed twice to break the west door of the Water Temple, revealing a critical vulnerability in their plan and drawing attention from the cultists inside.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realizes the Greater Temple had forces on this level all along, hidden in plain sight.
source_quote: I knew. The Greater Temple had not kept its forces below. They had forces on this level, in the parts of the map we had never walked, sitting quiet behind brown marble while we ran our little war for them floor by floor.

subject: Altar Basin
fact: The altar basin holds a shallow pool of water, filled with scattered coins, gems, and seashells — an offering left by the faithful or the desperate. Touching it would be sacrilege.
source_quote: Its concave top holding a shallow basin of water, and at the bottom of the basin — coins, a scatter of gems, seashells.

subject: basin of water
fact: The basin on the altar contains a scatter of coins, gems, and seashells as offerings.
source_quote: at the bottom of the basin — coins, a scatter of gems, seashells. An offering.

subject: bronze gargoyle value
fact: Bronze gargoyles, covered in verdigris, sat atop triangular plinths in the Water Temple's chamber.
source_quote: In each corner a triangular plinth ran up toward the vaulted dark, and atop each one a bronze gargoyle squatted under its coat of green.

subject: bronze sheet value
fact: A great sheet of bronze, covered in verdigris, was set into the west wall of the Water Temple.
source_quote: A great sheet of bronze set into the west wall.

subject: Calmer's mace
fact: Calmer's mace, a symbol of his authority and faith, is knocked against mercenaries' shins as he is carried; it has not been used since the wraith's defeat, and its silence mirrors his own powerlessness.

subject: chest delivered to Romag
fact: The Greater Temple has an interest in recovering a chest delivered to Romag.
source_quote: The chest we had delivered to Romag, which the Greater Temple had an interest in recovering.

subject: coins and gems value
fact: Coins and gems were part of the offering placed in the Water Temple's altar basin.
source_quote: coins, a scatter of gems, seashells. An offering.

subject: crock
fact: A crock half-full of mead is present on a table in the Air Temple chamber.
source_quote: a crock half-full of mead

subject: Dagger of Venom
fact: The Dagger of Venom is a poisoned blade gifted by Kelno, passed through the group, and intended to be used to kill Belsornig — now wielded by the infiltrator.
source_quote: The Dagger of Venom. Kelno's gift... I've been saving this to kill Belsornig for some time... the dagger had gone around the circle, and now it was coming back.

subject: Dagger of Venom
fact: The Dagger of Venom, gifted by Kelno to Zephyr, was used to kill Belsornig; it returned to Zephyr’s hand after the act, symbolizing the completion of a personal contract and the cyclical nature of vengeance.

subject: Dagger of Venom
fact: Zephyr carries the Dagger of Venom, a gift from Kelno, which he uses to kill Belsornig.
source_quote: And waiting in my hand: the Dagger of Venom. Kelno's gift... I crossed the last step, found the soft place under the ribs, and drove Kelno's gift home.

subject: Dagger of Venom value
fact: The Dagger of Venom is Kelno's gift, intended to kill Belsornig, and now wielded by Zephyr.
source_quote: the Dagger of Venom. Kelno's gift. *I've been saving this to kill Belsornig for some time.*

subject: ledger
fact: Kelno keeps a ledger detailing payments to a dozen names in the Air Temple.
source_quote: A ledger. Payments out to a dozen names.

subject: note
fact: A note reading "set out the second chair" is found in Kelno's possession, dated two weeks prior.
source_quote: a little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.

subject: seashell offering value
fact: A shallow basin in the Water Temple's altar held coins, gems, and seashells as an offering.
source_quote: coins, a scatter of gems, seashells. An offering.

subject: seashell offering value
fact: Seashells were part of the ritual offering in the Water Temple's altar basin.
source_quote: coins, a scatter of gems, seashells. An offering.

subject: Seaweed Drapery
fact: The seaweed drapery behind the serpentine idol is not decorative — it is organic, damp, and possibly alive. It moves subtly in the salt air, like a breath.
source_quote: with a seaweed drapery hung across the wall behind.

subject: seaweed drapery value
fact: A seaweed drapery hung across the wall behind the serpentine idol in the Water Temple.
source_quote: with a seaweed drapery hung across the wall behind.

subject: second chair
fact: Kelno placed a second chair in his chamber two weeks ago and sat across from it, waiting for Zephyr's group.
source_quote: He'd put the chair out two weeks ago and sat across from it, waiting for us.

subject: serpentine idol value
fact: A serpentine idol shaped as a writhing knot of fish, eels, and octopi stood in the alcove of the Water Temple.
source_quote: An idol of serpentine stone: a writhing knot of fish and eels and octopi sculpted into one horrid mass.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: skulls
fact: Human and demi-human skulls are arranged on shelves between scrolls and foodstuffs in the Air Temple chamber.
source_quote: on the shelves between the scrolls and the foodstuffs — skulls. Human, demi-human, arranged like a man arranges things he's stopped thinking about.

subject: the chest delivered to Romag
fact: The chest delivered to Romag is a key item of interest to the Greater Temple, implying it contains something of strategic or magical value. Its recovery is now a task assigned to the party, making them agents of the very power they sought to overthrow.
source_quote: The chest we had delivered to Romag, which the Greater Temple had an interest in recovering.

subject: The Ledger of Payments
fact: Kelno’s ledger contained records of bribes paid to a dozen names, revealing his long-term control over temple politics; the ledger was the physical proof of his influence and the foundation of the deal he offered Zephyr.
source_quote: A ledger. Payments out to a dozen names.

subject: The Obsidian Edge Note
fact: A warning note left by the enemy of Kelno, instructing assassins to withdraw from the steam corridors and avoid engaging the player group. It confirms that even those trying to kill Kelno’s puppet were ordered to spare the group — suggesting the group has become a feared, untouchable force.
source_quote: *If the obsidian edge appear in your hall, withdraw to the steam corridors. Do not engage. They are not to be killed.*

subject: The Second Chair
fact: A chair placed two weeks ago by Kelno, left empty and waiting. It symbolizes his anticipation of the player group’s arrival as the fourth temple. Its presence confirms he has been planning for their rise since Romag’s death. Now occupied by the group, it marks their formal entry into the power structure.
source_quote: He'd put the chair out two weeks ago and sat across from it, waiting for us.

subject: The Second Chair
fact: Kelno had placed a second chair in his chamber two weeks before Zephyr’s arrival, symbolizing his expectation that a new power would rise; its presence confirmed his foresight and willingness to submit to whoever proved strongest.
source_quote: A little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.

subject: treasury value
fact: The treasury of the Upper Temple is unaccounted for and of interest to the Greater Temple.
source_quote: A treasury unaccounted for.

subject: verdigris-covered bronze value
fact: Bronze in the Water Temple was covered in verdigris, indicating long neglect and symbolic decay.
source_quote: Bronze everywhere, all of it gone to verdigris, that green crust that says nobody has touched this in a long time...

subject: Barkinar's week-long deadline
fact: Barkinar gives the intruders one week to organize the Upper Temple before he returns.
source_quote: A week to organize the house. The house we came to burn.

subject: Calmer's god
fact: Calmer cannot say his god's name in the temple, and whispers it quietly to avoid exposure.
source_quote: I said it to the dark anyway, the way I'd been saying His name to the dark for weeks now — quiet, where no one could hear, where it couldn't blow my cover

subject: Calmer's identity
fact: Calmer is unsure if he is real or just a dream, as others treat him as irrelevant.
source_quote: Calmer is not with you guys. It's just a dream.

subject: Calmer’s Loss of Faith
fact: Calmer’s inability to speak his god’s name in the temple has eroded his spiritual authority and rendered his divine power unreliable; his internal struggle mirrors his physical removal from the war, suggesting a deeper collapse of identity and purpose.
source_quote: I said it to the dark anyway, the way I'd been saying His name to the dark for weeks now — quiet, where no one could hear, where it couldn't blow my cover...

subject: Falrinth
fact: Falrinth is a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own, but the details are not yet revealed.
source_quote: A second name, set down lighter, for later: Falrinth, a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own. 'We could talk about Falrinth later.'

subject: Falrinth’s Hidden Agenda
fact: Barkinar mentioned Falrinth, a rogue wizard hiding from the Greater Temple, as a potential future contact — hinting at a deeper conspiracy within the temple’s ranks that the party may be drawn into.

subject: Falrinth’s hidden agenda
fact: Falrinth, the wizard hiding from the Greater Temple, is mentioned as a potential future point of contact. His reasons for hiding and whether he is ally, enemy, or independent actor remain unknown — but his existence suggests a fracture within the Greater Temple’s control.
source_quote: We could talk about Falrinth later.

subject: keep him alive?
fact: A moment of hesitation arose over whether to spare Belsornig for interrogation — but the group chose immediate execution, forfeiting potential leverage.
source_quote: Maybe we should keep him alive? No?... 'No, let's just kill him,' Sequoia said.

subject: Kelno’s betrayal or coercion
fact: Kelno’s presence as a prisoner, and Barkinar’s knowing smile at him, suggest he is either a traitor, a double agent, or a victim of psychological manipulation. His role in the party’s past actions and his current status are critical unknowns.
source_quote: Barkinar looked at him and smiled. I filed that.

subject: One of you is going to die today
fact: Calmer repeats the phrase "one of you is going to die today" quietly to himself as he is carried away, but does not believe it applies to him.
source_quote: *One of you is going to die today.* The cold sat in my chest and did not leave. *But not me.* I didn't even believe it.

subject: One of you is going to die today
fact: The wraith declares, "one of you is going to die today," a phrase echoed by Calmer in his delirium.
source_quote: the wraith had agreed with him — *one of you is going to die today*

subject: The Chest Delivered to Romag
fact: Barkinar mentioned a chest delivered to Romag that the Greater Temple wants recovered — implying the party’s earlier actions were part of a larger game, and that the chest may contain something of critical importance.

subject: The Cleric’s True Role
fact: The party allowed Barkinar to believe Calmer was their leader; this deception may be exploited later, but also risks exposure if Calmer’s true condition or authority is revealed.

subject: the cleric's true role
fact: The party’s assumption that Calmer is their leader is a misperception actively reinforced by the Greater Temple. Whether Calmer is truly incapacitated, complicit, or being used as a pawn remains unresolved — and his true role may determine whether the party can reclaim agency.
source_quote: The cleric is in charge, of course." "He's hurt. He will be fine.

subject: The Cold in Calmer's Chest
fact: A persistent, whispering cold has taken root in Calmer’s chest since the wraith’s defeat; it speaks to him in voices that undermine his identity, questions his worth, and mirrors Zephyr’s dismissive attitude — suggesting it may be a supernatural effect, a psychic wound, or a divine punishment.

subject: the hill giant and ogres
fact: The presence of a hill giant and ogres in the meeting chamber confirms the Greater Temple’s overwhelming force advantage and its intent to prevent escape. Their existence raises the question: how many other hidden enforcers remain undiscovered in the temple?
source_quote: The room at the bottom was built to remove the question of whether we could fight our way out. A hill giant. Ogres at the walls.

subject: The Loyal Man’s Burden
fact: Dren’s loyalty is a liability in a world of mercenaries. Protecting him means protecting Calmer. But if Calmer dies, Dren breaks. If Dren dies, the mission collapses. The temple’s survival hinges on a man who cannot speak his god’s name and the one who will not betray his captain.
source_quote: Put Dren where the cleric was, and let the only loyal man in the temple guard the only man who couldn't run.

subject: The Name That Cannot Be Spoken
fact: Calmer’s inability to speak his god’s name is not a flaw — it is a sacred wound. The temple’s magic may be tied to it. To force him to speak it may awaken something — or kill him.
source_quote: He just couldn't say his own god's name in here...

subject: The Nature of Power
fact: The group has begun to realize that power here is not about loyalty or ideology — but appetite, timing, and the willingness to exploit chaos. Kelno’s honesty — 'I am for chaos, but I'm also for living' — becomes the new standard. The group now operates not as rebels, but as the inevitable victors.
source_quote: *There it is.* That was the genuine article. Not loyalty — appetite, the clean honest hunger of a man who only wants to wake up tomorrow.

subject: The Nature of Victory
fact: Zephyr’s group has won not through direct conquest but by orchestrating the self-destruction of rival factions; the question remains whether their victory is sustainable, or merely the next stage in the temple’s endless cycle of betrayal.
source_quote: One does not simply take bribes to defect and end up the rightful lords of anything. We ended up here anyway.

subject: The Prophecy of Death
fact: The wraith declared, 'One of you is going to die today,' and Zephyr echoed it; Calmer believes it won't be him, but the cold whispers otherwise — raising the question of whether the prophecy refers to physical death, spiritual death, or the death of leadership itself.

subject: The Unclaimed Throne
fact: The group has occupied the position of the fourth temple without realizing it. The throne was theirs the moment Hartsch and Romag died. The realization that they are the victors — not because they won a battle, but because others died — changes their entire approach to governance and control.
source_quote: We just hadn't sat down. *This is starting to be a very lucrative operation.*

subject: Who is the Real Leader?
fact: The party's leadership is in flux: Calmer believes he is the boss, but Zephyr is acting as commander; the conflict between their visions of authority is unresolved, and the temple's survival may depend on which man’s will prevails — or if both are merely pawns of a deeper force.

subject: who is this?
fact: The question 'You're not supposed to be here? Who is this?' was asked twice by cultists, signaling the collapse of the infiltration’s secrecy — and became the moment the infiltrators had to improvise their cover.
source_quote: You're not supposed to be here. Who is this?

subject: Zinnia’s Failure to See
fact: Zinnia, the party’s observer, failed to detect the Greater Temple’s hidden forces on the Upper Temple’s level — a lapse that now haunts him and may indicate he is being manipulated or that the enemy’s stealth exceeds his capabilities.

subject: after the Fire Temple surrender
fact: The events following the Fire Temple’s fall occurred in immediate succession, with no temporal gap between the surrender, appointment, and planning for the Water Temple.
source_quote: Go find the captain of the Fire Guard. Let's go find your troops, organize the place, make it clean.

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: Emridy Meadows
fact: Frostbrand was taken as a trophy during the fall of Emridy Meadows — a historical event marking the beginning of its imprisonment and the rise of the Fire Temple’s dominance.
source_quote: Since Emridy Meadows. Picked up as a trophy.

subject: Emridy Meadows
fact: Frostbrand was taken as a trophy from Emridy Meadows.
source_quote: A very long time, it said. Since Emridy Meadows. Picked up as a trophy.

subject: session
fact: Calmer has been turning the title 'Prophet Calmer' over in his mind all session.
source_quote: Chief Cleric. Loyal henchmen. Subordinate to Dren. The whole hierarchy laid out clean as a writ, and the commander nodding along like a man signing a confession he hasn't read. ... Prophet would be finer still — I had been turning the word over all session, the weight of it, *Prophet Calmer* —

subject: session date
fact: The events described occurred during a single, continuous session of exploration and revelation in the temple complex, marked by escalating tension, identity shifts, and the discovery of a sentient weapon.
source_quote: That was when Calmer turned. ... I noted it and kept moving.

subject: session date
fact: The events occurred during a session where the party entered the Water Temple, triggered its defenses, and began claiming its treasures — the day deserved a little flourish.
source_quote: because the day deserved a little flourish

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: session date
fact: This encounter occurs during the current session, marked by the culmination of combat and the immediate onset of a tense, wordless negotiation that redefines the party’s role from conquerors to potential treaty-makers.
source_quote: The salamander stopped fighting. It knelt. It set its weapon down — point to the floor, both hands open.

subject: session duration
fact: The events described occurred over the course of a single campaign session, during which Calmer assumed leadership, subdued the Fire Temple commander, and integrated Frostbrand into his arsenal.
source_quote: I had been turning the word over all session, the weight of it...

subject: Session Timeline
fact: The events described occurred within a single campaign session, marked by rapid conquests: Fire Temple subdued, Water Temple ambushed, and leadership structures reorganized — all within hours of each other.
source_quote: I had been turning the word over all session...

subject: Ambush at the Water Temple
fact: The party triggered a defensive mechanism in the Water Temple by touching the bronze bas-relief, awakening stone gargoyles as guardians — leading to a violent confrontation in which Calmer summoned radiant spirits to annihilate three of the four constructs, demonstrating his mastery over divine forces.
source_quote: I reached for the swirling spirits. They came the way they always come for me... the first gargoyle nearest the spirits simply ended — there one instant, gone the next.

subject: Appointment of New Head Cleric
fact: The former Fire Cleric was granted authority over the remnants of the Fire Guard after swearing allegiance to the Earth Temple and renouncing her former leader, Alrrem.
source_quote: Go find the captain of the Fire Guard. Let's go find your troops, organize the place, make it clean.

subject: Ascension of Calmer
fact: Calmer formally declared himself Chief Cleric and supreme ruler of the Upper Temple, reorganizing the command structure by installing Dren Halveth as his subordinate and asserting absolute authority over all surviving temple forces, including former enemies.
source_quote: I am the boss. Yes, I am." / "I kept finding that, lately — Zephyr isn't wrong, the title fits, the chain holds, and the men keep handing me their swords hilt-first.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer demanded to be called 'the Prophet of the Earth Temple' while opening the chest.
source_quote: Calmer chose the moment before the lock to demand we start calling him the Prophet, the Prophet Calmer, the Prophet of the Earth Temple.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer reached for the swirling spirits.
source_quote: I reached for the swirling spirits.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'Even I was quicker than her this time.'
source_quote: Even I was quicker than her this time.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'I am glad we all agree on this point.'
source_quote: I am glad we all agree on this point.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'I do not wrestle, members of the Earth Fire Temple.'
source_quote: I do not wrestle, members of the Earth Fire Temple,

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'I poured water. At least I didn't put fire on the water temple.'
source_quote: I poured water. At least I didn't put fire on the water temple.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'I want to kill them! I want them dead! I want every last one of them dead, dead, dead!'
source_quote: I want to kill them! I want them dead! I want every last one of them dead, dead, dead!

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer said, 'I was hoping you would ask.'
source_quote: I was hoping you would ask.

subject: Calmer being named St. Cuthbert's
fact: Frostbrand names Calmer as St. Cuthbert's in the Fire Temple.
source_quote: Then it caught Calmer. Named him for St. Cuthbert's, out loud, in a temple where that name is a death sentence.

subject: Calmer claiming leadership
fact: Calmer declares himself Chief Cleric of the Upper Temple after a readjustment of leadership.
source_quote: I let it be known that there had been a recent readjustment of the supreme leadership of the Upper Temple, and that I was now in charge.

subject: calmer defers to zinnia
fact: Calmer, after being challenged by Zinnia, deferred to her judgment on whether he was going too deep, acknowledging her as a professional spy.
source_quote: He looked at me for a moment. Then he deferred — said I understood the art of spying, that if I told him he was going too deep, he would believe me.

subject: Calmer's assertion
fact: Calmer declares himself Chief Cleric and supreme authority of the Upper Temple.
source_quote: the Obsidian Edge and the Chief Cleric is myself, Calmer.

subject: calmer's false prophet claim
fact: Calmer demanded to be called 'the Prophet of the Earth Temple' despite not being a true cleric of that faith, revealing his identity crisis.
source_quote: Calmer chose the moment before the lock to demand we start calling him the Prophet, the Prophet Calmer, the Prophet of the Earth Temple.

subject: Calmer's final authority
fact: Calmer asserts control over the Fire Temple by naming the surrendered cleric as head Cleric.
source_quote: Alright. You're head Cleric.

subject: Calmer's Revelation
fact: Calmer’s false identity as the Prophet of the Earth Temple was exposed by Zinnia, and his desperate clinging to titles during the chest-opening revealed his internal collapse — the cover had become his cage.
source_quote: He wasn't asking whether the deal was sound. He was asking whether the prophet of the Earth Temple could be seen shaking hands with fire.

subject: Calmer's spirit invocation
fact: Calmer summons radiant spirits that dismantle three gargoyles with ease.
source_quote: I reached for the swirling spirits. They came the way they always come for me... the first gargoyle nearest the spirits simply ended.

subject: Calmer using radiant spirits
fact: Calmer invokes radiant spirits to destroy three gargoyles in the Water Temple.
source_quote: I reached for the swirling spirits. They came the way they always come for me, that wheeling radiant guard of them, and I walked into the hall *with* them, the way a man walks into his own house. The first gargoyle ... simply ended ... The second buckled ... the third caught the edge of the wheel and staggered, slowed, sloughing stone, torn down to half of what it had been.

subject: Commander
fact: Commander handed over two gold coins.
source_quote: The commander handed over two gold pieces, very confused, holding them out like a man tipping the executioner.

subject: Commander
fact: Commander refused to go down without a fight.
source_quote: I won't go down without a fight!

subject: Commander
fact: Commander replied, 'Nor will I.'
source_quote: Nor will I,

subject: commander's surrender
fact: The commander surrenders his position and allegiance after being overwhelmed by force and psychological pressure.
source_quote: You know, I never really liked Alrrem.

subject: commander surrendering gold
fact: The commander hands over two gold coins to Zephyr, trembling like a man tipping an executioner.
source_quote: The commander handed over two gold pieces, very confused, holding them out like a man tipping the executioner.

subject: Discovery of Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand was discovered in a fire pit by Sequoia, who recognized its unnatural cold as a danger, and after it coughed and spoke, it became a sentient object of potential power — but one that rejected Zephyr and remained unclaimed.
source_quote: It said yes. I asked the only question that mattered. 'Are you gonna kill me if I touch you?' It seemed offended by the suggestion.

subject: establishment of Calmer's authority
fact: Calmer formally declared himself Chief Cleric of the Upper Temple and established a chain of command placing Dren Halveth above the defeated Fire Temple commander, asserting absolute authority through ritualized subordination.
source_quote: I let it be known that there had been a recent readjustment of the supreme leadership of the Upper Temple, and that I was now in charge.

subject: fire cleric becoming head cleric
fact: Zephyr names the fire cleric as the new Head Cleric after her surrender.
source_quote: "Alright. You're head Cleric," I said, releasing her and brushing a cushion's worth of dust off my sleeve.

subject: fire cleric being subdued
fact: Zephyr, Zinnia, and Sequoia perform a group hug to subdue the fire cleric and pin her dagger.
source_quote: Four of us crossed the lavish little room and converged on her like long-lost cousins. I got there first, and I got there *perfectly* — arms locked, weight set, the grab landing so clean it almost made me laugh. Then Zinnia folded in behind me, the second hold sliding home off the first, smooth as a closing drawer. Sequoia ducked under and pinned the legs.

subject: Fire Temple Commander
fact: The Fire Temple commander recognized Zephyr as the interloper who killed Alrrem and destroyed his temple.
source_quote: oh, it's you. The obsidian edge, the interlopers who killed Alrrem, destroyed my temple, massacred my forces.

subject: Fire Temple Surrender
fact: The Fire Temple’s last cleric was subdued in a group embrace, coerced into submission, and formally appointed as head of the Fire Guard under Earth Temple authority.
source_quote: Let's all go hug him together to surprise him.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand accepted Sequoia as its wielder despite his neutral alignment, recognizing him as exactly what it needed.
source_quote: You, you are exactly what I was looking for.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand named Calmer for St. Cuthbert's, a death sentence in the temple.
source_quote: Then it caught Calmer. Named him for St. Cuthbert's, out loud, in a temple where that name is a death sentence.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand recognized Vorkal as its former jailor and demanded satisfaction.
source_quote: It saw the salamander. It started talking — to Vorkal, in whatever language salamanders curse in — and the whole thing turned. Old jailor, old prisoner.

subject: frostbrand chooses sequoia
fact: The sentient sword Frostbrand selected Sequoia as its wielder, declaring him 'exactly what I was looking for' despite his neutral alignment.
source_quote: It looked at me. Also a possibility. And then it looked at Calmer ... and instead it came back to me. 'You, you are exactly what I was looking for.'

subject: Frostbrand choosing Sequoia
fact: Frostbrand chooses Sequoia as its wielder.
source_quote: It looked at Zinnia. A possibility. It looked at me. Also a possibility. And then it looked at Calmer, and for one long second I thought it had found its man — and instead it came back to me. "You, you are exactly what I was looking for."

subject: frostbrand demands vengeance
fact: Frostbrand declared that it and Sequoia would defeat the evil of the Temple of Elemental Evil and have their vengeance.
source_quote: It announced that the two of us would sneak around and kill creatures, that we would defeat the evil of the Temple of Elemental Evil and have our vengeance, on and on.

subject: frostbrand names calmer as st. cuthbert's
fact: Frostbrand aloud named Calmer as 'St. Cuthbert's,' a death sentence in the temple, forcing Zephyr and Zinnia to intervene.
source_quote: Then it caught Calmer. Named him for St. Cuthbert's, out loud, in a temple where that name is a death sentence.

subject: Frostbrand's Awakening
fact: Frostbrand awoke from its prison, recognized Sequoia as its true wielder, confronted its jailor Vorkal, and declared its purpose — forcing the party to reckon with ancient grudges and moral alignments beyond their mission.
source_quote: It pointed at Zephyr first. Zephyr is neutral. The sword said no... and then it came back to me.

subject: Frostbrand speaking
fact: Frostbrand speaks aloud and identifies itself as sentient.
source_quote: The sword coughed. A real cough. Out loud, from a length of steel that had no throat to do it with.

subject: Gargoyle Annihilation
fact: Three of the four gargoyles were destroyed by the narrator’s summoned radiant spirits — one shattered instantly, one buckled under gnawing radiance, one staggered and was torn down to half its form.
source_quote: The first gargoyle... simply ended... The second buckled... The third... staggered, sloughing stone, torn down to half of what it had been.

subject: gargoyles animating
fact: The gargoyles in the Water Temple animate and detach from their pillars after Zephyr knocks on the bronze bas-relief.
source_quote: The idol began to rotate. ... and then, because the day deserved a little flourish, the gargoyles came off their pillars. Wings unfolding. Stone going from stone to *intent.*

subject: salamander identifies vorkal as jailor
fact: Frostbrand recognized the salamander Vorkal as its former jailor from Emridy Meadows and demanded satisfaction.
source_quote: It saw the salamander. ... Old jailor, old prisoner. ... It had been the one trapped in the box, with Vorkal as its guard, the whole time.

subject: Salamander's Surrender
fact: The salamander knelt and laid down its weapon, not in defeat but as a tactical negotiation — a moment that shifted the party from combatants to potential allies and triggered a chain of revelations about the deeper conflict beneath the temples.
source_quote: It stopped. It knelt. It set its flaming spear down on the stone.

subject: Salamander surrender
fact: The salamander ceased hostilities, knelt, and laid down its weapon — an unprecedented act that shifted the encounter from combat to negotiation, triggering a silent, non-verbal negotiation among the party to interpret its intent.
source_quote: The salamander stopped fighting. It knelt. It set its weapon down — point to the floor, both hands open.

subject: salamander surrender
fact: The salamander knelt and set its flaming spear down, offering a contract in exchange for knowledge about the Greater Temple.
source_quote: It stopped. It knelt. It set its flaming spear down on the stone. ... A contract. ... it knows things. About the Greater Temple.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Frostbrand declared that Sequoia and it would sneak around and kill creatures to defeat the Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: It announced that the two of us would sneak around and kill creatures, that we would defeat the evil of the Temple of Elemental Evil and have our vengeance

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia accepted Frostbrand as his weapon, despite its coldness and danger.
source_quote: I'll take it," I said. I let it down into my actual hand, against my better judgment

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia carved into his own gargoyle.
source_quote: Sequoia carved into his own, deep

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia confirmed to Frostbrand that he had taken things when no one was counting.
source_quote: I have taken things when no one was counting. That is the file.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia discovered the sword in the chest was sentient after it coughed.
source_quote: The sword coughed. A real cough. Out loud, from a length of steel that had no throat to do it with.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia flipped the chest over to avoid triggering a trap, revealing the cold sword among the loot.
source_quote: What if I just flip the chest over? Let it fall out. The items went onto the floor in a heap.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia refused to touch Frostbrand directly without a glove, suspecting a trap.
source_quote: I don't trust this. At all. I'll let the hand that isn't a hand do it.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia revealed to Frostbrand that he had killed Romag and participated in a three-way war.
source_quote: We killed Romag. Ran a three-way war and let it eat itself. I have taken things when no one was counting.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia said, 'Kill him.'
source_quote: Kill him,

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia told Frostbrand they were on an undercover mission, which the sword did not weigh heavily.
source_quote: We're kind of on an undercover mission right now," I said, which it did not seem to weigh as heavily as I would have liked.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia was chosen by Frostbrand as the one who was 'exactly what I was looking for.'
source_quote: It looked at me. Also a possibility. And then it looked at Calmer... and instead it came back to me. 'You, you are exactly what I was looking for.'

subject: Sequoia opening the chest
fact: Sequoia opens the chest and avoids a blade trap.
source_quote: Sequoia opened the box. A blade cut the air where his throat would have been and found nothing — his hands had already moved him clear.

subject: Sequoia taking Frostbrand
fact: Sequoia takes Frostbrand into his hand and survives its cold.
source_quote: I let it down into my actual hand, against my better judgment, and the cold sat there and did not kill me.

subject: Surrender of the Fire Commander
fact: The Fire Temple’s commander surrendered not through battle, but through the ritualized exchange of two gold coins — a transaction that functioned as a symbolic act of fealty, marking the end of the Fire Temple’s autonomy and the beginning of Earth Temple dominance.
source_quote: Two gold coins for sparing your life, please." / "The coins meant nothing. The handing-over meant everything.

subject: takeover of the Fire Temple throne room
fact: Calmer and Zephyr entered the Fire Temple’s throne room, confronted its fallen commander, and through a staged reversal of intent and symbolic payment of two gold coins, secured his submission and integration into the new hierarchy.
source_quote: The chamber beyond was a hot, bright thing — reds and oranges and yellows, torchlight on lacquered wood, tapestries celebrating the triumph of elemental fire across every wall.

subject: Temple Awakening
fact: The Water Temple awoke in defensive response to improper contact — gargoyles detached, the idol rotated, and spiritual forces were summoned to purge the trespasser.
source_quote: The temple was now improperly touching back. The gargoyles came off their pillars. Stone going from stone to intent.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr accepted the salamander’s terms: it keeps the Fire Temple and kills Water Temple stragglers in exchange for intelligence.

subject: Zephyr

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr asked, 'Where's the gold you have there?'
source_quote: Where's the gold you have there?

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr braced wrong and always thought of the wrong muscle under pressure.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr read the infernal contract and struck out clauses that demanded soul or ownership.

subject: Zephyr

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr recognized the infernal contract as something tieflings have seen before.
source_quote: He didn't flinch. He's seen these before.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr reversed course at speed.
source_quote: No, I lied. It's okay. You can continue being a Fire Temple soldier. We will leave you be.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'If you're so excited, you should start killing.'
source_quote: If you're so excited, you should start killing.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'Let's all go hug him together to surprise him.'
source_quote: Let's all go hug him together to surprise him.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, 'Now we are leaders, and you must conduct yourselves.'
source_quote: Now we are leaders, and you must conduct yourselves.

fact: Zephyr said, 'Two gold coins for sparing your life, please.'
source_quote: Two gold coins for sparing your life, please.

fact: Zephyr shook hands with the salamander despite knowing it would burn him.

fact: Zephyr told the commander, 'I will not forget this.'
source_quote: I will not forget this,

source_quote: Zephyr cut himself and signed. Then he put out his hand to shake — into a creature that would burn him for the contact.

subject: Zephyr's leadership claim
fact: Zephyr declares himself and his group the new bosses of the temple hierarchy.
source_quote: We are the new bosses, so,

subject: Zinnia

source_quote: You're not a real cleric for the Earth Temple.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia interpreted the salamander’s surrender as a sign of shifted power, not mercy.
source_quote: A creature made of heat does not kneel unless the odds have already turned against it.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed that Calmer’s objections were being written by his cover identity, not his true self.
source_quote: The cover was speaking again, and it was getting louder.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia told Calmer he was going too deep in his deception, and Calmer accepted it as truth.
source_quote: I think you're going in too deep." ... "I understood the art of spying, that if I told him he was going too deep, he would believe me.

subject: Zinnia
